jobs.title: Project Manager Engineering 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  We are looking for a motivated and experienced Project Manager Engineering or Lead Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead and manage converter system projects from sales\/tender phase to initiation and through to completion, ensuring Engineering deliverables are on time, within budget, and in line with quality requirements.  How you'll make an impact  Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects in Engineering within defined timelines and budgets   Lead the technical solution development during sales and tender phase for Engineering.  Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in close collaboration with stakeholders   Coordinate internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth project execution   Communicate project plans, progress, and expectations clearly and proactively   Assess resource requirements and ensure effective allocation throughout the project lifecycle   Track Engineering project milestones, timelines, and deliverables using appropriate tools   Identify technical risks early, manage changes in scope, and implement suitable mitigation measures   Lead, coach, and motivate project team members, fostering accountability and high performance   Conduct project reviews and capture key learnings, deriving actionable recommendations for future improvements  Your background   Master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering   Minimum 5 years of experience in project execution within an engineering environment   Experience with power systems and converter systems is a plus  Proven track record in managing complex engineering projects   PMP or equivalent certification is an advantage   Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills   Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment   Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills   Fluency in English is required; German is a plus  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Internship in IT Onsite Support 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our collaborative OSS team and support daily IT operations close to the business. You ensure employees have reliable devices and a smooth digital workplace experience. In this hands‑on role, you learn how to troubleshoot technical issues and prepare essential IT equipment. You work closely with end users and gain valuable insights into how IT drives productivity. Throughout the 12 months internship, experienced colleagues support your growth and development. How   you'll   make an impact Assist   in troubleshooting basic IT issues, p repare laptops and other devices so they are ready for use by new or existing employees Support end users   in   navigating self ‑ service tools and standard IT procedures Assist with stock handling, asset pickup\/return, and device preparation for onboarding\/offboarding Support warranty processes by gathering information and preparing devices Help   maintain   IT equipment in meeting rooms and shared office spaces, ensuring systems   operate   correctly Update documentation related to device preparation and OSS procedures and report issues to the team.   Be   engaged in special projects where you   make impact ( relocating , changing office set-up,   set   up infrastructure,   set-up   of the meeting rooms)   Be engaged in special   on ‑ site   projects, such as office relocations,   changes   to office layouts, infrastructure setup, and preparation or reconfiguration of meeting rooms, contributing directly to how the workplace functions   Your background Currently studying at a university or technical school (EFZ) in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field Comfortable working with people   and with   following established procedures   and   you are passionate about making things better Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems Eager to learn and develop technical skills in a hands ‑ on environment Strong problem ‑ solving mindset and good attention to detail Good communication skills in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

titleByLocale.it: Stage in IT Supporto in loco 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Stage dans le soutien informatique sur place 80 - 100% (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti al nostro team di OSS collaborativo e supporta le operazioni IT quotidiane vicino al business. Garantisci ai dipendenti di avere dispositivi affidabili e un'esperienza di lavoro digitale fluida. In questo ruolo pratico, impari come risolvere problemi tecnici e preparare attrezzature IT essenziali. Si lavora a stretto contatto con gli utenti finali e ottenere preziose informazioni su come l'IT guida la produttività. Durante i 12 mesi di stage, colleghi esperti sostengono la vostra crescita e sviluppo. Come farete un impatto Assist nella risoluzione dei problemi IT di base, nel ripristino dei computer portatili e di altri dispositivi in modo che siano pronti per l'uso da parte di dipendenti nuovi o esistenti Supporta gli utenti finali nella navigazione di strumenti di self-service e procedure IT standard Assistere con la gestione delle scorte, il recupero degli asset\/ritorno e la preparazione dei dispositivi per i problemi di bordo\/offboarding Processi di garanzia di supporto raccogliendo informazioni e preparando i dispositivi IT Essere impegnato in progetti speciali in cui si effettua l'impatto (locazione, cambiamento dell'assetto dell'ufficio, istituire infrastrutture, impostare le sale riunioni) Essere impegnato in progetti speciali sul sito, come rilocali per uffici, modifiche ai layout per uffici, installazione delle infrastrutture, preparazione o riconfigurazione delle sale riunioni, contribuendo direttamente a come funziona il luogo di lavoro Attualmente studiando presso una scuola universitaria o tecnica (EFZ) in IT, informatica, ingegneria o un campo correlato Lavorare con le persone e con le seguenti procedure consolidate e si è appassionati di rendere le cose migliori La comprensione di base dell'hardware e dei sistemi operativi Eager per imparare e sviluppare competenze tecniche in una mani ‐ su ambiente Forte problema ‐ risolvere mindset e buona attenzione ai dettagli Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e tedesco Più su di noi Siamo una società di sviluppo continuo con un forte focus
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie unserem kollaborativen OSS-Team bei und unterstützen Sie den täglichen IT-Betrieb in der Nähe des Unternehmens. Sie stellen sicher, dass Mitarbeiter über zuverlässige Geräte und ein reibungsloses digitales Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verfügen. In dieser praktischen Rolle lernen Sie, wie Sie technische Probleme beheben und wichtige IT-Geräte vorbereiten können. Sie arbeiten eng mit Endbenutzern zusammen und gewinnen wertvolle Erkenntnisse darüber, wie IT die Produktivität antreibt. Während des 12-monatigen Praktikums unterstützen erfahrene Kollegen Ihr Wachstum und Ihre Entwicklung. Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen Assist bei der Fehlersuche grundlegende IT-Probleme, p repare Laptops und andere Geräte, so dass sie bereit sind für den Einsatz durch neue oder bestehende Mitarbeiter Unterstützung Endbenutzer bei der Navigation Self-Service-Tools und Standard-IT-Prozeduren Assist bei der Bestandsabwicklung, Asset Pickup / Return und Gerätevorbereitung für Onboarding Support Garantieprozesse durch das Sammeln von Informationen und Vorbereitung von Geräten Hilfe bei der Wartung IT-Ausrüstung in Besprechungsräumen und gemeinsam genutzten Büroräumen, um sicherzustellen, dass Systeme korrekt funktionieren Aktualisieren Sie die Dokumentation in Bezug auf Gerätevorbereitung und OSS-Verfahren und melden Sie Probleme an das Team. Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten, bei denen Sie etwas bewirken (Umzug, Änderung der Büroeinrichtung, Einrichtung der Infrastruktur, Einrichtung der Besprechungsräume) Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten vor Ort, wie Büroverlagerungen, Änderungen an Bürolayouts, Infrastruktureinrichtung und Vorbereitung oder Neukonfiguration von Besprechungsräumen, die direkt dazu beitragen, wie der Arbeitsplatz funktioniert Ihr Hintergrund Derzeit studieren an einer Universität oder technischen Schule (EFZ) in IT, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich Komfortable Arbeit mit Menschen und mit den folgenden etablierten Verfahren und Sie sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die Dinge besser Grundlegendes Verständnis von Computer-Hardware und Betriebssystemen Eager zu lernen und zu entwickeln technische Fähigkeiten in einer Hand - auf Umwelt Starke Problemlösung Denkweise und gute Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung.
• Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Anschreibens und einer Niederschrift der Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Universitätszertifikat erforderlich ist, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Bestandteil Ihres Studiums ist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'occasion Joignez-vous à notre équipe collaborative OSS et soutenez des opérations informatiques quotidiennes proches de l'entreprise. Vous vous assurez que les employés ont des appareils fiables et une expérience de travail numérique en douceur. Dans ce rôle pratique, vous apprenez comment résoudre les problèmes techniques et préparer les équipements informatiques essentiels. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs finaux et obtenez des informations précieuses sur la façon dont l'informatique stimule la productivité. Pendant les 12 mois de stage, des collègues expérimentés soutiennent votre croissance et votre développement. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Aider à résoudre les problèmes informatiques de base, à remplacer les ordinateurs portables et autres appareils afin qu'ils soient prêts à être utilisés par des employés nouveaux ou existants Aider les utilisateurs finaux à naviguer des outils d'auto-service et des procédures informatiques standard Aider à la manutention des stocks, à la récupération d'actifs et au retour, et à la préparation des appareils pour les processus de garantie à bord et hors-bord Soutenir les processus de garantie en recueillant de l'information et en préparant des appareils Aider à maintenir l'équipement de TI dans les salles de réunion et les bureaux partagés, en veillant à ce que les systèmes fonctionnent correctement Mettre à jour la documentation relative à la préparation des appareils et aux procédures SSO et signaler les problèmes à l'équipe. S'engager dans des projets spéciaux où vous faites impact (relocalisation, changement d'agencement, mise en place d'infrastructures, mise en place des salles de réunion) S'engager dans des projets spéciaux sur le site, tels que des déménagements de bureaux, des modifications à la disposition des bureaux, la configuration de l'infrastructure et la préparation ou la reconfiguration des salles de réunion, contribuant directement au fonctionnement du lieu de travail Votre expérience Vous étudiez actuellement dans une université ou une école technique (EFZ) en informatique, en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe Travaillant confortablement avec les gens et en suivant les procédures établies et vous êtes passionné par l'amélioration de la compréhension de base du matériel informatique et des systèmes d'exploitation Evidemment apprendre et développer des compétences techniques dans un environnement ‐ sur l'environnement Problème fort ‐ résoudre l'état d'esprit et une bonne attention aux détails Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie et fortement axée sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

jobs.title: Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  This role offers the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the digital transformation and continuous improvement agenda within GCB. As Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics, you will work at the intersection of business, data, and technology, driving data driven initiatives that improve operational efficiency, transparency, and decision-making quality. You will design and deliver scalable digital and analytics solutions using modern cloud technologies, enabling standardized KPIs, reliable insights, and sustainable automation. By collaborating closely with business and IT stakeholders, you will directly contribute to measurable performance improvements and support the organization's long-term digital maturity.    How you'll make an impact  Lead digital and continuous improvement projects from concept to rollout and stabilization   Define project scope, milestones, KPIs, governance, and success criteria aligned with business priorities   Ensure data availability, quality, consistency, and compliant usage across GCB   Design and implement cloud based analytics and data processing solutions   Work extensively with Databricks for data ingestion, transformation, analysis, and modeling   Identify process inefficiencies and implement automation to reduce manual effort and cycle times   Enable standardized KPIs and transparent reporting for management decision-making   Proactively manage risks, dependencies, resources, and stakeholder expectations  Your background  Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related STEM field   2- 3 years relevant working experience  Strong data engineering and analytics skills (SQL, relational databases, cloud analytics, Databricks)   Solid understanding of SAP S\/4HANA data  Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate)   Proven track record delivering digitalization, process automation, and improvement initiatives   Structured, analytical mindset with strong business communication skills   Excellent project management, ownership, and execution focus   Collaborative, proactive, and self-driven with a passion for digital innovation and continuous improvement  Business fluent in English and German    More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di svolgere un ruolo chiave nella definizione dell'agenda di trasformazione digitale e miglioramento continuo all'interno del GCB. In qualità di responsabile del progetto di miglioramento – Data & Digital Analytics, lavorerai all'incrocio tra business, dati e tecnologia, guidando iniziative basate sui dati che migliorano l'efficienza operativa, la trasparenza e la qualità decisionale. Potrai progettare e fornire soluzioni digitali e analytics scalabili utilizzando le moderne tecnologie cloud, consentendo KPI standardizzati, insight affidabili e automazione sostenibile. Collaborando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT, contribuirai direttamente a migliorare le prestazioni misurabili e sostenere la maturità digitale a lungo termine dell'organizzazione. Condurre progetti di miglioramento digitale e continuo da concept a rollout e stabilizzazione Definire l'ambito di progetto, le pietre miliari, i KPI, i criteri di governance e di successo allineati alle priorità aziendali Assicurare la disponibilità dei dati, la qualità, la coerenza e l'utilizzo conforme in GCB Design e implementare soluzioni di analisi e elaborazione dati basate su cloud. Corso di laurea o master in informatica, ingegneria, o un campo STEM correlati 2- 3 anni esperienza lavorativa rilevante Forte ingegneria dei dati e competenze di analisi (SQL, database relazionali, analisi cloud, Databricks) Solida comprensione dei dati SAP S\/4HANA Esperienza con Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Un'eccellente gestione del progetto, la proprietà e l'esecuzione focalizzano la collaborazione, la proattiva e l'autodidatta con la passione per l'innovazione digitale e il miglioramento continuo. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Sie entwerfen und liefern skalierbare Digital- und Analyselösungen mit modernen Cloud-Technologien, die standardisierte KPIs, zuverlässige Erkenntnisse und nachhaltige Automatisierung ermöglichen. jobs.title: Scientist in Physics and Scientific Programming (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in modelling and simulation of complex physical phenomena to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions to improve the performance and reliability of power grids devices, such as transformers, circuit breakers, power semiconductors. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all!  How you'll make an impact   You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background    PhD in physics with strong theoretical background or in applied mathematics Proven expertise in collaborative software development, visualization and working with large code bases Practical experience with usage of simulation software and tools for engineering problems Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity   More about us     At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.  Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description: The opportunity    Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  How you'll make an impact  Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety  Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems  Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures  Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes  Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications  Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures  Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations  Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment  Your background  Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering  Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment  Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems  Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures  Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills  Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment  English is mandatory, German is beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Technical Buyer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. As a Technical Buyer, you act as a key interface between Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and our global supplier network. You ensure that technically specified materials, components, and services are clearly defined, technically clarified, qualified, and available in line with project, quality, and delivery requirements. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. How you'll make an impact Perform technical clarification of materials, drawings, specifications, and engineering changes in close collaboration with Engineering and suppliers Support and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities, first samples, and supplier qualification processes Conduct technical evaluations of alternative materials, deviation requests, and obsolescence cases Collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Buyers on supplier- and material-related topics Support the handling of supplier complaints, Non‑Conformity Reports (NCRs), and root cause analyses Support and participate in supplier assessments and technical supplier evaluations, including capability, quality, and process maturity reviews Contribute to supplier performance evaluations together with Quality and Strategic Procurement Ensure accuracy and completeness of material and supplier master data in SAP and act as the technical contact point during supplier escalations Support Service Organization and Project Teams in complex or urgent procurement topics Your background Completed technical education (e.g. Polymechanic, Automation Technician, Mechanical Technician, Design Engineer or similar) 3-5 years experience in technical procurement or SCM‑related roles Strong understanding of technical drawings, Bill of Material and manufacturing processes Experience working with suppliers on technical and quality‑related topics Structured, solution‑oriented, and communicative working style Good German skills and very good English skills SAP knowledge Proactive, structured, and solution-focused working style. Team oriented mindset with strong cross-functional collaboration More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy, Prodotti ad alta tensione La nostra azienda è nota a livello mondiale come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di Servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale per i sistemi di circuito-breaker per generatori (GCB) e per le sostanze di commutazione isolate con gas (GIS), compresi la formazione, l'installazione e la commissione, la manutenzione programmata, i servizi di valore aggiunto, la risoluzione dei problemi, gli estensioni, i retrofit e le sostituzioni. Descrizione del ruolo Come Acquirente Tecnico, agirai come interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete globale di fornitori. Assicurerai che i materiali, i componenti e i servizi specificiti tecnologicimente chiaramente definiti, chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con le esigenze dei progetti, della qualità e della consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduirai le esigenze di ingegneria in soluzioni di approvvigionamento robuste e supporterai la qualifica dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il tuo ruolo diretto alla qualità dei prodotti, alla affidabilità delle forniture e all'eccellenza operativa, volendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per l'energia ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come realizzare un impatto - Esegui la chiarificazione tecnica dei materiali, dei disegni, delle specifiche e delle modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con l'Ingegneria e i fornitori. - Supporta e coordina le attività del Processo di Approvazione dei Parti di Produzione (PPAP), le prime prove e i processi di classificazione dei fornitori. - Conduci le necessarie tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e boss di obsolescenza. - Collabora diretta con gli Acquirenti Strategici e Operativi sui temi relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali. - Supporta l'organizzazione e la gestione delle lamentele dei fornitori, dei Rapporti di Non Conformità (NCR) e delle analisi di causa radice. - Supporta e partecipa alle competenze dei fornitori e alle dirette tecniche dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni della capacità, della qualità e della maturità dei processi. - Contribuisce alle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme con la Qualità e la Procurement Strategica. - Assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei dati di master dei materiali e dei fornitori nel SAP e agiscono come punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori. - Supporta l'Organizzazione di Servizio e le Squadre di Progetto in materia di approvvigionamento complessivo o urgenti.
• Requisiti - Educazione tecnica completata (ad esempio Polimematico, Tecnico di Automazione, Tecnico Meccanico, Ingegnere di Progetto o simili) - 3-5 anni di esperienza in approvvigionamento tecnico o ruoli correlati allo SCM - Buona comprensione dei disegni tecnici, della Lista di Materiali e dei processi di produzione - Esperienza nel lavoro con i fornitori su temi tecnici e di qualità - Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientaleto alla soluzione e comunicativo - Buone abilità in tedesco e ottimi livelli di inglese - Conoscenza di SAP - Stile di lavoro proattivo, strutturato e orientale alla soluzione - Mindset orientaleto al team con forte collaborazione interfunzionale Cosa? - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che ti aiuti a ottimizzare il rendimento personale e professionale e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possano sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

En tant que directeur des ventes de la région, vous allez prendre en charge la croissance des affaires dans votre région et façonner activement notre succès sur le marché. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients et les partenaires, en positionnant notre portefeuille de pointe et en proposant des solutions répondant à des exigences techniques et commerciales complexes. En vous joignant à notre équipe internationale et hautement expérimentée, vous aurez une connaissance approfondie de l'activité à haute tension tout en contribuant directement à des systèmes énergétiques durables et fiables. Ce rôle offre une occasion unique de combiner expertise technique et responsabilité commerciale et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir de l'énergie. Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants internes tels que l'ingénierie, la gestion de projet et les équipes de service pour offrir des solutions compétitives et axées sur le client - Analyser les tendances du marché, les besoins des clients et les activités des concurrents pour positionner notre portefeuille de manière proactive et renforcer notre présence sur le marché - Favoriser la prise de commandes et la croissance des recettes tout en assurant l'alignement sur les objectifs opérationnels et les priorités stratégiques - Soutenir les clients tout au long du cycle de vie des projets, en assurant un haut niveau de satisfaction et en identifiant les opportunités de nouvelles affaires Vos antécédents - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les ventes techniques, la gestion des comptes clés ou un rôle similaire pour le client, idéalement dans le secteur énergétique ou industriel - Diplôme (Bachelor ou Master) en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou dans un domaine technique connexe, complété par une solide compréhension commerciale - Expérience éprouvée dans la vente de produits ou de systèmes techniques complexes, avec la capacité de gérer le cycle de vente complet et de conclure des contrats avec succès - Expérience de travail avec les clients à différents niveaux et fonctions, y compris la capacité de renforcer la confiance, d'influencer les décisions et de gérer les négociations difficiles - Une bonne compréhension du marché de l'énergie, de l'industrie manufacturière ou du secteur des systèmes, idéalement avec une exposition aux sous-stations ou aux technologies de commutation - L'esprit d'entreprise avec une approche proactive et orientée vers la solution, combinée avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et de faire avancer les sujets - Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation, avec une mentalité collaborative et la capacité de travailler efficacement dans des équipes internationales et interfonctionnelles - Volonté de voyager (environ 20%) Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician Power Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Transformers After Sales team in Zürich, Switzerland, and play a hands-on role in powering the nation! As a key player, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining and enhancing the reliability and longevity of power transformers all across Switzerland. Step into a position where your expertise truly makes a difference!    How you´ll make an impact Apply and enforce Hitachi Energy safety standards during all onsite operations.  Perform installations, and quality.  Identify potential service opportunities and communicate them to the Sales team.  Collaborate closely with customers, project teams, suppliers and other stakeholders, ensuring clear descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro dinamico Transformers After Sales team di Zurigo, Svizzera, e gioca un ruolo pratico nel potere della nazione! Come giocatore chiave, sarete in prima linea nel mantenere e migliorare l'affidabilità e la longevità dei trasformatori di potenza in tutta la Svizzera. In questo ruolo, influenzerai direttamente la stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità unica di lavorare insieme a aziende leader nel settore energetico svizzero. Ogni giorno affronterai nuove sfide tecniche, garantirai l'esecuzione sicura e di alta qualità del lavoro sul campo critico e rappresenterai con orgoglio la reputazione di Hitachi Energy per l'eccellenza tecnica e la soddisfazione del cliente. Entra in una posizione in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero la differenza! Applicare e far rispettare gli standard di sicurezza Hitachi Energy durante tutte le operazioni in loco. Eseguire installazioni, manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, ispezioni e revisioni sui trasformatori di potenza in conformità con le procedure interne. Pianificare, coordinare e ottimizzare gli interventi sul campo per garantire efficienza e qualità. Identificare potenziali opportunità di servizio e comunicarle al team Vendite. Collabora a stretto contatto con clienti, team di progetto, fornitori e altri stakeholder, garantendo una comunicazione chiara e tempestiva. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione del servizio. Completa tutti i report, la documentazione e i record di qualità esattamente nel sistema di tracciamento interno. Il vostro fondo certificato federale di competenza (CFC) in meccanica, manutenzione industriale, elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato (ad esempio, fabbro, meccanico, polimeccanico, tecnico di automazione). Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sul campo rilevante è considerato un bene. Volontà di viaggiare attraverso la Svizzera per lunghi periodi (minimo 1 settimana) e occasionalmente lavorare in 2×8 turni. Forte senso di responsabilità e alta consapevolezza dei requisiti di sicurezza. Licenza valida del conducente della categoria B. Buon comando del tedesco, con inglese e francese come lingue di lavoro aggiuntive. Conoscenza dei cablaggi elettrici e diagrammi elettrici Capacità di saldatura Motivazione per seguire la formazione interna sull'assemblaggio dei trasformatori e gli interventi sul campo, inclusa la formazione avanzata nelle fabbriche Hitachi Energy Maggiori informazioni su di noi Responsabilità emozionanti e varie con ampio spazio per autonomia e creatività Opportunità interessanti per ulteriori formazione e sviluppo personale Compiti e progetti interessanti e diversi – tra cui incarichi internazionali Un team ben coordinato e dinamico Una cultura aziendale aperta e di supporto Un pacchetto di compensazione attraente, tra cui stipendio fisso, spese di viaggio e di pasto, così come l'opportunità di avere una voce nel regime di alloggio

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez notre dynamique équipe Transformers After Sales à Zurich, en Suisse, et jouez un rôle pratique dans le pouvoir de la nation ! En tant que joueur clé, vous serez à l'avant-garde du maintien et de l'amélioration de la fiabilité et de la longévité des transformateurs de puissance partout en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez un impact direct sur la stabilité du réseau électrique suisse et aurez l'occasion unique de travailler avec des entreprises de premier plan du secteur énergétique suisse. Chaque jour, vous vous attaquerez à de nouveaux défis techniques, assurerez une exécution sûre et de haute qualité des travaux critiques sur le terrain et représenterez fièrement la réputation d'Hitachi Energy pour son excellence technique et sa satisfaction de la clientèle. Entrez dans une position où votre expertise fait vraiment une différence! Comment vous ferez un impact Appliquer et appliquer les normes de sécurité de l'énergie Hitachi pendant toutes les opérations sur place. Effectuer les installations, l'entretien préventif et correctif, les inspections et les révisions des transformateurs de puissance conformément aux procédures internes. Planifier, coordonner et optimiser les interventions sur le terrain pour assurer l'efficacité et la qualité. Identifier les possibilités de service et les communiquer à l'équipe des ventes. Collaborer étroitement avec les clients, les équipes de projet, les fournisseurs et les autres intervenants, en assurant une communication claire et opportune. Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisation de services. Remplir avec précision tous les rapports, la documentation et les dossiers de qualité dans le système de suivi interne. Vos antécédents Certificat fédéral de compétence (CFC) en mécanique, entretien industriel, électromécanique ou dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., serrurier, mécanicien, polymécanique, technicien en automatisation). Au moins deux années d'expérience sur le terrain sont considérées comme un atout. Volonté de voyager à travers la Suisse pendant de longues périodes (minimum 1 semaine) et de travailler occasionnellement en 2×8. Un fort sens des responsabilités et une grande sensibilisation aux exigences de sécurité. Permis de conduire de catégorie B valide. Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand, l'anglais et le français étant des langues de travail supplémentaires. descriptionByLocale.it: Come operatore di macchine (w\/m\/d), siete un membro prezioso della nostra produzione e contribuire direttamente alla qualità dei nostri prodotti con la vostra comprensione tecnica e un'attenta operazione. Insieme al vostro team, vi assicurerete che la produzione si esaurisca e che i nostri elevati standard in termini di sicurezza, qualità ed efficienza siano soddisfatti in qualsiasi momento. Si può fare questo versando i feedthrough, nonché formando e disfacendo gli organi di avvolgimento che operano e monitorano il sistema in resina di colata, tra cui pre e post-elaborazione Documentazione dei valori di produzione e di processo Riparazione di piccoli disturbi e partecipazione ai lavori di manutenzione e manutenzione Condurre controlli di qualità sui prodotti fabbricati Mantenere tutta la sicurezza, la qualità e le normative ambientali Questo è ciò che si porta con la vostra sicurezza esplicita e la consapevolezza di qualità comprensione tecnica di base e interesse per i processi produttivi Formazione tecnica completa o ulteriore formazione (ad esempio guide di impianti) di vantaggio disponibilità a lavorare in funzionamento a 3 turni Buona conoscenza tedesca (almeno B1) Esperienza nel trattare con dighe, gru o piattaforma di sollevamento Più su di noi Sicurezza sul posto di lavoro in una società orientata al futuro Varied Un ambiente di lavoro collegiale con comunicazione aperta Vantaggi sociali attraenti e condizioni di lavoro moderne
descriptionByLocale.en: About the position As a Machine Operator (w\/m\/d), you are a valuable member of our production and contribute directly to the quality of our products with your technical understanding and careful operation. Together with your team, you will ensure that production runs smoothly and that our high standards in terms of safety, quality and efficiency are met at any time. You can do this by pouring the feedthroughs as well as forming and unpacking the winding bodies operating and monitoring the casting resin system including pre- and post-processing Documenting of production and process values Repairing small disturbances as well as participation in maintenance and maintenance work Conducting quality controls on manufactured products Keeping all safety, quality and environmental regulations Active cooperation in improving processes and processes This is what you bring with your express safety and quality awareness basic technical understanding and interest in production processes Complete technical training or further training (e.g. plant guides) of advantage willingness to work in 3-shift operation Good German knowledge (at least B1) Experience in dealing with dikes, crane or lifting platform More about us Safe workplace in a future-oriented company Varied A collegial working environment with open communication Attractive social benefits and modern working conditions

descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos de la position En tant qu'opérateur de machines (w\/m\/d), vous êtes un membre précieux de notre production et contribuez directement à la qualité de nos produits grâce à votre compréhension technique et au bon fonctionnement. Avec votre équipe, vous vous assurerez que la production se déroule bien et que nos normes élevées en matière de sécurité, de qualité et d'efficacité sont respectées à tout moment. Vous pouvez le faire en versant les flux ainsi qu'en formant et en déballant les corps d'enroulement qui actionnent et surveillent le système de résine de coulée, y compris le pré-traitement et le post-traitement Documentage des valeurs de production et de processus Réparation de petites perturbations ainsi que participation aux travaux d'entretien et d'entretien Conduite de contrôles de qualité sur les produits manufacturés Maintien de toutes les réglementations en matière de sécurité, de qualité et d'environnement Coopération active dans l'amélioration des processus et des procédés C'est ce que vous apportez avec votre sensibilisation à la sécurité et à la qualité une compréhension technique de base et un intérêt pour les processus de production Une formation technique complète ou une formation continue (p. ex. guides d'usine) d'avantage volonté de travailler en 3 équipes Bonne connaissance allemande (au moins B1) Expérience dans le traitement des digues, grues ou plate-forme de levage Plus sur nous Un lieu de travail sûr dans une entreprise orientée vers l'avenir Varié Un environnement de travail collégial avec une communication ouverte Des avantages sociaux attrayants et des conditions de travail modernes

jobs.title: R&D Team Leader - Bipolar Semiconductors 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to advancing a sustainable energy future for all by empowering the brightest minds to push technological boundaries. Join a diverse global community that thrives on collaboration, innovation, and purpose. We are looking for an experienced R&D Team Lead with a strong background in power semiconductor technologies and a proven track record in leading and developing high-performing R&D teams. How you'll make an impact Lead, manage, and develop a team of R&D engineers, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and accountable team culture Take full responsibility for team delivery, including resource planning, performance management, and team development Own the end-to-end development of bipolar semiconductor devices, from concept to manufacturing transfer Define and execute R&D strategies aligned with business goals and technology roadmaps Drive innovation in materials, device architectures, and fabrication processes Collaborate closely with process engineering, product management, and manufacturing to ensure successful industrialization Actively monitor emerging technologies and market trends in power semiconductors Guide and review technical work, ensuring high quality standards and technical excellence Oversee project execution, including timelines, budget, and risk management Prepare and review technical documentation, presentations, and patent applications Your background PhD or master's degree in physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline with strong grounding in semiconductor device physics Several years of experience in semiconductor R&D, including proven experience in leading and managing R&D teams Solid track record in people management, including performance management, coaching, and team development Extensive hands-on experience in power semiconductor devices (e.g. IGBTs, power MOSFETs, diodes, thyristors) or related applications Demonstrated ability to drive technical delivery through others in a complex R&D environment Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills Experience in managing cross-functional teams and influencing without authority Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance technical depth and leadership responsibilities Passion for developing people, driving innovation, and building high-performing teams More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. 
• We offer Discounted conditions in our daycare centres in Baden and Oerlikon Extra days off between Christmas and New Year 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discounts on memberships at various fitness centres Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund Promotion of diversity and inclusion Numerous exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy

Les hommes Diriger, gérer et développer une équipe d'ingénieurs en R-D, favorisant une culture d'équipe de haute performance, collaborative et responsable Prendre l'entière responsabilité de l'exécution de l'équipe, y compris la planification des ressources, la gestion du rendement et le développement de l'équipe Posséder le développement de bout en bout de dispositifs bipolaires à semi-conducteurs, du concept au transfert de fabrication Définir et exécuter des stratégies de R-D alignées sur les objectifs opérationnels et les feuilles de route technologiques Favoriser l'innovation dans les matériaux, les architectures d'appareils et les procédés de fabrication Collaborer étroitement avec l'ingénierie des procédés, la gestion des produits et la fabrication pour assurer une industrialisation réussie Surveiller activement les technologies émergentes et les tendances du marché des semi-conducteurs électriques Guider et examiner les travaux techniques, garantir des normes de qualité élevées et l'excellence technique Superviser l'exécution du projet, y compris les délais, le budget et la gestion des risques Préparer et examiner la documentation technique, les présentations et les demandes de brevet ##
• Requisiti Doctorat ou maîtrise en physique, en génie électrique, en sciences des matériaux ou dans une discipline connexe ayant une solide base en physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs Plusieurs années d'expérience en R-D sur semi-conducteurs, y compris une expérience éprouvée dans la direction et la gestion d'équipes de R-D Une solide expérience en gestion des personnes, y compris la gestion du rendement, l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes Expérience pratique étendue des dispositifs à semi-conducteurs de puissance (par exemple IGBT, MOSFET de puissance, diodes, thyristors) ou applications connexes Capacité démontrée de diriger la prestation technique par d'autres dans un environnement complexe de R-D Fortes compétences en relations interpersonnelles, en leadership et en gestion des intervenants Expérience dans la gestion des équipes interfonctionnelles et influence sans autorité Une forte prise en main de l'entreprise et la capacité d'équilibrer la profondeur technique et les responsabilités en matière de leadership Passion pour le développement des personnes, la conduite de l'innovation et la constitution d'équipes performantes
• Cosa offriamo Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir. -

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Physics of Failure & Reliability (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability. We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems.  As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you'll bridge theory and application, developing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to facilitate the energy transition. How you'll make an impact You drive impact : Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Descrizione - L'opportunità Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. - In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. - Il tuo ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. - Questa è la vostra opportunità di modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi in termini di stabilità, uptime e prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprieta', prospera in un ambiente frenetico e si diverte a fare un vero impatto? Allora applica oggi! Mansioni - Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore - Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer, in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore) - Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati - Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione - La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita - Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito
• Requisiti - Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. - Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. - Analizzare i dati del processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (attuazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). - Pianificazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. - Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. - Obblighi di invio nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di invio) concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call. Cosa? - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Project Management Portfolio Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  In this role, you will take a key position at the heart of our project organization, driving excellence across a diverse project portfolio within Hitachi Energy. As Project Management Portfolio Manager, you will shape and continuously improve our project execution strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices.  You will lead and develop a high-performing PMO team, while partnering closely with senior stakeholders, Project Managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex projects successfully. By combining strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, you will strengthen our project management framework, support critical business decisions, and enable sustainable growth.  This is a unique opportunity to make a visible impact on both operational performance and organizational development, while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability.  How you'll make an impact  Contribute to implement continuous improvements for the project execution strategy for the local project operation, in alignment with BU and GPG business strategies  Develop and continuously improve processes based on industry's best practices. Ensure that findings from lessons learned from project execution are incorporated in continuous improvement actions  Participate in bid or sales phase which involves activities such as estimating and resource planning  Oversee project management activities at the portfolio level through project reviews with the management team and Project Managers  Oversee the proper application of contract and claim management methods in accordance with Hitachi Energy's policies, and contractual agreements  Lead the PMO team to establish and enforce an effective project management approach to achieve both project and organizational goals   Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders of the PMO  Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background  Master or Bachelor in the field of engineering or economics  Min. 5 years extensive Project Management experience with EPC component as well as in the electrical field  Deep knowledge about taking full ownership of the execution of complex projects and financial reporting  Proven track record of extensive leadership experience with staff responsibility  English proficiency is required, additional language skills are meritorious  Experience in transmission and distribution industry from advantage  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Process Lead - Transformer Cores Fabrication
jobs.description: The opportunity The Global Manufacturing Process Lead - GPG DT - Transformer Cores Fabrication is responsible for defining, leading, and continuously improving the end-to-end engineering and manufacturing-related processes for transformers magnetic cores within the Global Product Group (GPG), covering distribution transformers, dry-type transformers, and traction transformers. This role has a strong focus on core manufacturing processes, including lamination handling, cutting, stacking, core assembly, clamping, insulation interfaces, losses control, dimensional accuracy, and industrialization readiness, ensuring alignment between design, manufacturing, suppliers, and digital platforms. The position supports the “Design Anywhere, Manufacture Anywhere” strategy by standardizing processes, enabling digital tools, and ensuring that best practices in core manufacturing engineering are consistently deployed across factories worldwide. The role drives Lean, Digital Transformation, and Value Stream improvements, ensuring speed, quality, and robustness of magnetic core processes while reducing manual activities and variability. Close collaboration with Factory Engineering Process Managers, Digital Transformation Leads, Platform\/Tool teams, and Supply Chain is essential. How you'll make an impact You own global engineering and manufacturing processes for magnetic cores. You set clear standards that ensure quality, consistency, and efficiency. You standardize how cores are designed, built, and assembled worldwide. You ensure processes scale across factories and production volumes. You review processes regularly and drive continuous improvement. You improve efficiency, quality, and lead times through structured improvements. You identify where automation and digital tools add real value. You define requirements for tools that support design and manufacturing. You connect engineering with operations, supply chain, and suppliers. You lead a global network that applies standards safely and consistently. Your background You hold a degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering, or similar. Or you bring equivalent long‑term practical experience. You have extensive experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. You bring deep exposure to magnetic cores or transformer manufacturing. You understand industrial processes for complex electromechanical products. You have a strong background in process engineering and continuous improvement. You have led complex initiatives across functions and countries. You work confidently with digital tools that support engineering and production. You communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders effectively.​ More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation. Specific benefits depend on the location and will be communicated during the interview process. Applications are open until 15th of June.

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter/in Endprüfung 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Mitarbeiter Endprüfung bei Hitachi Energy bist du ein entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Produktion und Auslieferung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte vor der Freigabe höchsten Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Dokumentationsanforderungen entsprechen. Mit deinem Qualitätsbewusstsein und deinem strukturierten Vorgehen trägst du maßgeblich zur Zuverlässigkeit unserer Produkte und zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden bei. Das kannst du bewirken Testen von Generatorleistungsschaltern im Prüffeld (80%): Prüfen der Generator Leistungsschalter gemäss vorgegebenem Prüfplan Bewertung der Messergebnisse Durchführung von Kundenabnahmen in Englischer Sprache Erkennen von mechanischen und elektrischen Fehlern Analyse und Korrektur von Verdrahtungsfehlern im Steuerschrank Übernahme der Verantwortung für das Prüfen der zugeteilten Schalter (zeitlicher Ablauf sowie Qualität der Prüfung) Mitarbeit bei der Verbesserung des Messequipments sowie der Prüfprozesse Montage- und Verdrahtungsarbeiten (20%): Selbstständige Verdrahtung von Baugruppen und Schaltersystemen gemäss Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenauftrag, Elektroschema, Checkliste und Arbeits­plan Montage von PGHV-Produkten entsprechend der in den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen festgehaltenen Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen Lesen und verstehen von technischen Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung (Automatiker EFZ, o.ä.) Erfahrung im lesen und verstehen von elektrischen Schemas, Montagezeichnungen und Arbeitsanweisungen Kenntnisse der Prüfung elektrischer Maschinen und von Steuerschränken sind von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mündlich, schriftlich) Affinität zu Computern (Messequipment, diverse Softwaretools, Dokumentation erstellen und pflegen) Gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie kundenorientiertes Denken und professioneller Umgang mit Kunden Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

jobs.title: Scientist in Generative AI and Large Language Models (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist with expertise in Large Language Models and Generative AI to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic, motivated, and creative team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all.   How you'll make an impact   You are creative : Conduct high-quality industrial research in the areas of Generative AI and Large Language Models for sustainable power grids, green energy and related fields You are impactful: Develop innovative software solutions, turn them into prototypes and increase their technology readiness towards productization You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Business Units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in technical reports, patent applications, and scientific publications   Your background   PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field Proven expertise in GenAI technologies spanning Large Language Models, reasoning methods, and agentic systems, with strong knowledge of relevant algorithms, frameworks, and tools Expertise in scalable and high-performance computing Good knowledge of the NVIDIA AI\/ML SW technology stack Strong ability and keen interest in applying AI to real-world industrial applications and business cases related to the energy sector and driving the emerging research in this field toward productization Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, both written and spoken

jobs.title: Junior Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. How you'll make an impact Improve the process capability of module assembly processes, by applying statistical tools, designed experiments and gemba principles Analyse production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial or mechanical Good understanding of automation, experience in robot handling is advantageous Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in English, German highly beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Internship in Planning & Fulfillment 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our collaborative team for a 12 months internship in Zürich-Altstetten and gain hands-on experience in a global industrial environment. You will support a highly skilled Planning & Fulfillment team within our Insulation & Components product group, a worldwide leader in high-voltage transformer bushings. In this role, you contribute to essential operational processes while building strong analytical and organizational capabilities. You will learn how international supply chains operate and how data drives decision-making. You grow through close guidance, meaningful tasks, and an encouraging team culture. This role is ideal for someone curious, detail-oriented, and eager to make a real impact.  How you'll make an impact Support the Planning & Fulfillment team with administrative tasks Prepare and maintain regular reports and data analyses Help ensure data accuracy across planning systems Collaborate with internal stakeholders across departments Support continuous improvement initiatives within the team Contribute ideas to optimize reporting and workflows Your background Basic commercial education First experience in an administrative or office role Strong communication skills and team spirit Structured and detail-oriented working style Good knowledge of MS Office tools Fluent in German and English More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Internship in Variability Visualization Framework for Large-Scale Graphical Languages 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
