jobs.title: Internship on Power Systems of the Future 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join a dynamic research team shaping the future of energy systems. You will explore how renewable energy, smart grids, and sector coupling are transforming power systems worldwide. This 6 months internship offers a unique chance to contribute to next-generation solutions while developing your skills in a supportive and flexible environment. You'll work closely with experts across business units and gain valuable insights into innovation and sustainability. How you'll make an impact Perform market analysis on renewables and smart grid topics Derive system and product requirements based on the market analysis Define high-level functional architectures for future solutions Simulate future energy scenarios and technologies Model emerging technologies across power system levels (e.g. DC grids, electro-mobility, energy storage, electrolyzes and fuel cells, demand response, etc.) Develop, maintain and document new techno-economic assessment tools for simulating behavior of energy systems on different time scale Build future energy scenarios on regional and global scales Your background Currently pursuing a M.S. degree in electrical engineering or completed a similar M.S. degree less than 12 months ago Familiar with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi) integrated into simulation workflows developed in MATLAB and Python Experience with renewable energy and smart grid technologies, solutions, and concepts, combined with proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, or similar Excellent communicator in English, both in writing and speaking Background in the following power system topics: steady-state and dynamic stability analysis and modeling, fault analysis and power system protection, energy and ancillary service markets Self-starter with a strong willingness to learn, capable of working independently while also being a reliable and collaborative team player More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency.  In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

jobs.title: Internship in Low-Code Development 80 - 100% (f/m(d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working  Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Functional Lead Secondary Engineering Standardization Team 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team.   Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Teamleiter Instandhaltung 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position In unserem Profit Center in Wettingen produzieren und offerieren wir innovative, zuverlässige und sichere Überspannungsschutzlösungen für die Segmente Stromerzeugung\/-verteilung sowie Railway und Industrie. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit mit hochwertigen Technologien zu unterstützen und nachhaltige Mehrwerte zu schaffen. Dies gelingt durch die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kerntechnologien sowie durch die stetige Verbesserung unserer Prozesse – getragen von offener Zusammenarbeit und einem starken Teamgeist. Als Teamleiter Instandhaltung übernimmst du eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle und führst ein engagiertes Team von sechs Mitarbeitenden. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für die zuverlässige Funktion aller Produktionsanlagen und technischen Systeme in einer hochautomatisierten Prozessfertigung. Aktiv gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung der Instandhaltung – sowohl strategisch als auch operativ – und arbeitest dabei eng und partnerschaftlich mit der Geschäftsleitung sowie anderen Bereichen zusammen. jobs.description: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung   Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z.   B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus   Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: R&D Team Manager – Next Generation Grids Transformers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Hitachi Energy is seeking an experienced and motivated R&D Team Manager to lead our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva, Switzerland.   In this role, you will manage a team of 5+ engineers and drive the development of advanced and innovative technologies, including medium frequency transformers and power electronics enhanced transformers. You will combine people leadership with strong technical guidance and project ownership, contributing to the execution of R&D strategy in a global environment.  How you'll make an impact     Lead, develop, and motivate an international R&D team of 5+ engineers with know-how in medium frequency transformers, power converters and lab testing Provide technical leadership and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges  Contribute to R&D strategy and technology direction, including development of roadmaps for the New Generation Grids Transformers product line  Plan, drive, and deliver R&D projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and quality targets  Collaborate closely with global R&D teams, engineering functions, and external partners  Manage project resources and budgets to maximize impact and operational efficiency Site R&D laboratory and infrastructure responsibility, including driving expansion plans  Introduce and implement new tools, technologies, and processes to improve performance  Your background    Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field  Several years of industrial experience in product development, or technology management  Strong technical background in transformers and power converters  Proven experience in project management within R&D or product development  Experience in leading technical teams (line or project leadership) and working in international and cross-functional environments  Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) as well as stakeholder engagement capabilities  More about us You will join a collaborative and international R&D environment at the forefront of next-generation grid technologies. Working in Geneva, you will contribute to innovative transformer solutions that support the energy transition and the development of more flexible and sustainable power systems. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

jobs.description: The opportunity  As a Factory Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist part of the local HSE team, you will play a key role in participating to HSE development, with main focus on Environmental topic, but granting a good support on Health & Safety activities.  Key tasks on the Environmental side will be related to safeguarding our site's environmental integrity and driving our sustainability ambitions forward. In this role, you will ensure full compliance with all relevant environmental laws, regulations, and permits, while fostering strong relationships with community stakeholders and environmental authorities. You will develop, implement, and maintain robust environmental policies and procedures that promote accountability across the organization. By conducting environmental risk assessments, delivering training on sustainability practices, and leading initiatives that improve resource efficiency, you will directly contribute to reducing the factory's environmental footprint and supporting long-term operational excellence.  On the H&S part, you'll be required to support main Health and Safety development activities organized by the HSE Manager, delivering results according to Management expectations.  Please submit your application in English.   How you'll make an impact  Ensure regulatory compliance with Swiss environmental law and related frameworks (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), including permit management and coordination with cantonal authorities (BAFU)  Lead environmental impact assessments for new production lines, plant changes, and modifications, ensuring alignment with internal environmental policies  Manage waste and disposals, including segregation, traceability, registers, supplier audits, and all special waste streams, while supporting wastereduction and VVEA improvement initiatives  Oversee chemical compliance, including ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, Manage and maintain Safety SDS requirements, and notifications of new substances  Support safe handling and storage of dangerous goods (DG) by coordinating with relevant departments and ensuring ongoing compliance  Plan and conduct environmental audits and inspections, identifying improvement areas and ensuring timely corrective actions, also providing environmental compliance support and training to Engineering, Maintenance, and overall Business Unit, including REACH\/RoHS documentation and sustainability-related data needs  On the Health and Safety part, you're required to support HSE manager in H&S-related topics managing production activities and equipment with the highest safety standards, both on the practical part and on documentation preparation.  Support HSE reporting activities required by governmental or Hitachi Energy internal stakeholders.  Your background  Min. 3 years of experience in environmental roles within the industrial sector and strong knowledge of Swiss environmental regulations and compliance obligations   Solid understanding of best practices in emissions, waste, water, chemicals, and sustainability   Strong analytical skills, including environmental data processing and use of relevant software tools   Basic knowledge of H&S principles and concepts   Excellent command of Office 365 applications   Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess environmental risks and develop effective mitigation strategies   Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engaging with diverse internal and external stakeholders   Fluent in Italian and English  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Internship Application Development 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our IT team and contribute to modern application solutions in a dynamic environment. In this role, you support the full application lifecycle, from design to deployment. You work closely with experienced colleagues and gain hands‑on experience in development and system configuration. You will learn how digital applications create real business impact. Curiosity, ownership, and a structured mindset will help you succeed. You grow through responsibility, collaboration, and exposure to real projects. How you'll make an impact Develop and enhance IT applications and solutions while contributing to knowledge sharing Support installation maintenance optimization and ongoing operation of IT systems Contribute to application and software design aligned with business requirements Support end‑to‑end development including design build testing and deployment Write clean efficient and maintainable code following best practices Troubleshoot technical issues ensure performance security and scalability Participate in testing quality assurance and continuous improvement activities Document solutions processes and provide technical support to end users Your background Enrolled in IT and Computer Science or similar field (Bachelor or Master) Knowledge of modern application development tools and technologies Experience in at least one programming language (e.g.VB.Net, C#, C++, Microsoft SQL, HTM, Javascript, Python. Specify the languages relevant to the role) Knowledge of development platforms (e.g. AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft DevOps, Visual Studio, Microsoft Power Apps, Microsoft GitHub, Mulesoft, Microsoft BizTalk, Pega, Docker, Kubernetes) Understanding of software development lifecycle and ability to connect technical solutions with business needs Strong analytical and structured thinking More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Designer Bushings 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join a dynamic team at the forefront of high-voltage technology, where your creativity and precision will shape the future of custom-engineered bushings. As a Designer, you'll take ownership of innovative mechanical solutions, optimize designs for performance and manufacturability, and contribute directly to cutting-edge development projects. This is your chance to work hands-on with advanced tools like Creo and SAP, while driving continuous improvement in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment. If you're passionate about engineering excellence and ready to make a tangible impact, this role is made for you. How you'll make an impact Development and design of customer-specific high-voltage bushings Maintenance and creation of technical documentation, bills of materials, and master data in the SAP system Implementation of technical specifications and application of dimensional, form, and positional tolerances Optimization of existing designs with regard to efficiency, manufacturability, and quality Independent execution of smaller development projects or tool improvements Support in the continuous improvement of our processes and products Your background Completed training as a design engineer (EFZ) or a comparable qualification 3 to 5 years of professional experience in mechanical design or product design Solid knowledge of 3D design, ideally with Creo (PTC) Independent, reliable, and solution-oriented working style High level of initiative and sense of responsibility Very good German skills, both written and spoken; English skills are an advantage More about us   Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Project Management Engineering e-Mobility 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our dynamic Engineering team in Regional Center of Competence, Europe Hub, as a Project Manager Engineering and lead technically the execution and tendering of cutting-edge eMobility electric power supply infrastructure projects—including DC charging solutions for electric buses. You'll shape technical solutions, lead engineering efforts across MV & LV distribution systems and power conversion equipment and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive innovation and excellence. If you're passionate about sustainable mobility and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Take technical lead in execution and tendering of eMobility electrical infrastructure projects (e.g., bus depots, terminal charging stations), support and guide Local execution and tendering teams Own all engineering activities across project lifecycles—from concept to commissioning Collaborate internally with Local Operating Units responsible for project execution and tendering, Sales, R&D, Product engineers, Supply chain, Site Installation & Commissioning teams and externally with customers, suppliers Coordinate and supervise remote engineering teams for primary and secondary engineering tasks as applicable Design power supply system architectures, perform sizing calculations, and prepare technical specifications Evaluate supplier offers and support procurement processes with Supply Chain Management Provide technical expertise during tendering and project execution phases Translate customer requirements into optimized, compliant technical solutions Lead technical discussions with clients, resolve site queries, and ensure timely, high-quality deliverables Ensure safety, compliance, and engineering excellence throughout the project Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, with a focus on Power Electronics or Power Systems 7–10 years of experience in MV\/LV power distribution systems, electrical systems design & engineering Experience with DC power supply systems, power converters, energy storage, or harmonic filtering is a plus Strong knowledge of engineering tools and software (e.g., BIM, CAD, ETAP, MathCAD) Proactive, results-driven mindset with strong teamwork and communication skills Committed to safety, quality, and continuous learning Willingness to travel up to 10% for customer and project meetings Fluent in English and French More about us 
• We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

How you'll make an impact Take technical lead in execution and tendering of eMobility electrical infrastructure projects (e.g., bus depots, terminal charging stations), support and guide Local execution and tendering teams Own all engineering activities across project lifecycles—from concept to commissioning Collaborate internally with Local Operating Units responsible for project execution and tendering, Sales, R&D, Product engineers, Supply chain, Site Installation & Commissioning teams and externally with customers, suppliers Coordinate and supervise remote engineering teams for primary and secondary engineering tasks as applicable Design power supply system architectures, perform sizing calculations, and prepare technical specifications Evaluate supplier offers and support procurement processes with Supply Chain Management Provide technical expertise during tendering and project execution phases Translate customer requirements into optimized, compliant technical solutions Lead technical discussions with clients, resolve site queries, and ensure timely, high-quality deliverables Ensure safety, compliance, and engineering excellence throughout the project Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, with a focus on Power Electronics or Power Systems 7–10 years of experience in MV\/LV power distribution systems, electrical systems design & engineering Experience with DC power supply systems, power converters, energy storage, or harmonic filtering is a plus Strong knowledge of engineering tools and software (e.g., BIM, CAD, ETAP, MathCAD) Proactive, results-driven mindset with strong teamwork and communication skills Committed to safety, quality, and continuous learning Willingness to travel up to 10% for customer and project meetings Fluent in English and French More about us

jobs.title: Project Manager GIS High Voltage 80 - 100%
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you driven to create global impact through the leadership of complex, high-value projects? Do you combine strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities? Within Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Product Group, we are shaping the future of power transmission and distribution. In our global Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) business, based in Zürich-Oerlikon, we deliver advanced solutions with the highest standards of reliability and innovation. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of strategically important projects in a global, matrix organization. You will lead cross-functional teams across regions, act as a key interface to international customers, and drive successful project delivery while contributing to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end execution of complex, international projects from commercial handover to successful closure, ensuring delivery against scope, timeline, quality, and financial targets Act as the primary interface to global customers, building trusted relationships and leading high-impact engagements, including technical discussions and factory acceptance tests Drive proactive risk and opportunity management, applying a strategic mindset to ensure sustainable project outcomes Maintain full accountability for project performance, including financial steering, resource planning, and forecasting in close alignment with controlling Lead contract execution, including change and claim management, safeguarding both customer satisfaction and business interests Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams in a global setup Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and actively shape best practices within the project management function Your background Proven track record (7+ years) managing complex projects in an industrial or technology-driven environment, ideally with international exposure Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior customer representatives and internal leadership Strong commercial acumen with solid expertise in financial steering, risk management, and contract execution Confident communicator with the ability to influence, negotiate, and present effectively in an international context Experience working in matrix organizations and leading cross-cultural teams Relevant project management certifications (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are an advantage Fluent in German or French; business fluent in English is mandatory More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer high Voltage and Production Developer 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Industrial Engineering team, where team members work within two clearly differentiated focus areas: production development and industrial engineering. Each role has a defined main focus in one of these domains, while both profiles collaborate closely within the same team and contribute to shared production goals. Depending on your background, you will take ownership of one focus area while staying connected to the broader engineering activities. You will work hands‑on with production, engineering, and suppliers in a highly collaborative environment. This setup allows you to deepen your expertise while understanding adjacent processes. You will grow through real shopfloor impact, responsibility, and cross‑functional collaboration. How you'll make an impact Develop and optimize production equipment and processes Design mechanical components tools and technical solutions Support industrialization of new products and manufacturing concepts Improve efficiency quality and cost across production Develop and optimize high voltage production processes Analyze and solve electrical and technical production issues Ensure safe and compliant manufacturing concepts Collaborate with engineering quality and suppliers Your background Degree in mechanical or electrical engineering or similar field Solid understanding of mechanical or electrical systems Experience with technical drawings schematics or CAD tools Structured independent and solution‑oriented working style Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills Good communication skills in a technical environment More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: HSE Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Kaufmännischer Projektmanager – Transformatoren 80 – 100 % (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.   --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d)   The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: IT Application Compliance Manager 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for an Application Compliance Project Manager to support the definition, coordination, and execution of our global application compliance roadmap. In this role, you will work closely with the Head of Global IT Compliance and act as a key interface between Business Solution Teams, Global IT Governance, IRM, ServiceNow, and delivery teams. If you enjoy enabling teams, coordinating cross‑functional activities, and contributing to a consistent governance approach across the organization, this opportunity is for you. How you'll make an impact Support the definition and maintenance of the global application compliance roadmap Translate compliance strategy and policy into an actionable delivery plan Coordinate and guide application compliance activities across teams Serve as the primary interface between Business Solution Teams and core IT Drive consistent adoption of Application Lifecylce Management (ALM), Application Onboarding SOP and other compliance relevant instructions Coordinate delivery efforts with Global IT Governance, IRM, ServiceNow, and other teams Track progress, milestones, and cross‑team dependencies Identify risks or misalignments and escalate when needed Your background Strong ITIL background with demonstrated expertise in application management processes and their compliance, risk, and control implications, including experience in IT\/application compliance, assurance, or audit Proven experience in Global IT Governance, enterprise risk management (IRM), and executing cross‑functional roadmaps across multiple stakeholders Solid understanding of ServiceNow workflows and their use within governance, risk, and compliance processes Excellent project, stakeholder, and committee coordination skills, with the ability to organize, drive alignment, and deliver outcomes More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring together curious, collaborative people committed to continuous learning and positive impact. Diversity, inclusion, and teamwork are at the core of how we operate. With our innovative technologies and global reach, we support customers and partners in accelerating the energy transition and shaping a more sustainable world.

jobs.title: Befristet: Automatiker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Leistungshalbleitern bietet Hitachi Energy eines der vielfältigsten Produktportfolios. Darunter; Thyristoren, Dioden, Gate-Turn-Off-Thyristoren (GTOs), Integrated Gate-Commutated Thyristors (IGCTs), Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistors (IGBTs) und MOSFETs -, die in Industrie, Energieübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbaren Energien für ihre hohe Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit geschätzt werden. Für unser Team suchen wir befristet eine\/n Automatiker\/in, der\/die beim Aufbau und der Inbetriebnahme unserer Leistungshalbleiter-Testsysteme mitwirkt. Das kannst du bewirken Aufbau von Leistungshalbleiter-Testsystemen inklusive Mechanik, Elektrik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik Durchführung von Anpassungsarbeiten an fehlerhaften Konstruktionen, Fertigungsteilen oder Schemen Kontrolle aller mechanischen, pneumatischen, elektrischen, programmierten und hydraulischen Funktionen Durchführung von Erdungsmessungen (Überprüfung der Durchgängigkeit des Schutzleitersystems nach EN 60204-1 18b) Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Isolationskoordinationsprotokollen Durchführung der Inbetriebnahme und Isolationskoordination von Testsystemen Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Normvorgaben Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Prozessen und Systemen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Automatiker\/in EFZ (evtl. mit höherer Fachschule), idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung in der Montage Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Fundiertes Know-how in der mechanischen Bearbeitung von Materialien (Drehen, Fräsen, Bohren, Sägen etc.) Vertrautheit mit Leistungshalbleitern, Messtechnik sowie relevanten Richtlinien und Normen Sicherer Umgang mit Office 365 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Befristete Position in einem international führenden Hightech-Unternehmen Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle 
• Aufgaben im Bereich Leistungshalbleiter Offene Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Sozialleistungen und moderne Arbeitsmittel

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   
• We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

jobs.title: HR Employee Lifecycle & Immigration Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d) - 12-month contract
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a proactive and fast-learning HR Operations Specialist to temporarily join our team and support the Employee Lifecycle & Immigration processes.  This is a temporary position for 12 months and requires someone who can quickly adapt, take ownership, and deliver high-quality service in a dynamic, international environment. How you'll make an impact Manage and execute immigration processes for local hires and business travel, handling all types of work and residence permits from start to finish Ensure compliance with Swiss immigration regulations and internal procedures Provide high-level HR Operations support to HR colleagues, business managers, and employees, ensuring timely and accurate processing aligned with our Service Level Agreements Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries, offering clear and concise guidance on policies and procedures Handle activities across the Employee Lifecycle, including onboarding, changes, and offboarding Identify and suggest improvements based on feedback and operational experience Participate in process improvement projects and collaborate closely across HR Operations, HR Functions, and HR Business Partners Your background You hold a Swiss federal vocational certificate in HR or equivalent further education, ideally with a focus on immigration or HR Operations Minimum 2 years of experience in an international environment, ideally in immigration or HR Operations Solid understanding of Swiss labor law and immigration procedures Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Workday and ticketing tools is a plus Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines Excellent communication skills, customer service orientation, and a resilient, flexible mindset A team player who works independently and takes initiative Fluent in German and English; Italian or French is a plus More about us Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Head of Bid & Proposal Markt Schweiz 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Zur Verstärkung unserer Front-End-Sales-Organisation suchen wir einen Head of Bid & Proposal, der eine zentrale Rolle im Verkaufsteam Schweiz übernimmt. In dieser Funktion verantworten Sie das Bid Management sowie die Erstellung qualitativ hochwertiger und wettbewerbsfähiger Angebote für unser Portfolio von Hochspannungsprodukten und Transformatoren. Sie entwickeln das Bid-&-Proposal-Team weiter und führen es fachlich wie disziplinarisch. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinieren Sie sämtliche relevanten internen Stakeholder und tragen mit termingerechten, qualitativ überzeugenden Angeboten massgeblich zur erfolgreichen Entwicklung des Schweizer Marktes bei. Wir suchen eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zielerreichung und im Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams in einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld. jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Product Engineer – Power Semiconductors Module Packaging (BiMOS) 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Transport, Trade & Logistics Junior Specialist Export 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern   Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.
