jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - Grid Automation Control & Protection 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer or Technician - Diffusion/Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. jobs.title: Tender and Quotation Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist to join out team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland.  In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical or commercial education background. Bachelor's\/Master's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering Minimum of 3 years of experience in tender management, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner 1 year contract (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We're looking for a  Talent Acquisition Partner  to join our dynamic team and support our German-speaking market. In this role, you'll work closely local stakeholders and colleagues to attract top talent, drive local initiatives, and elevate candidate experience. If you're passionate about recruitment and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you! How you'll make an impact Drive end-to-end recruitment for roles on the German-speaking market across multiple functions and Business Units Act as an advisor to hiring managers, providing market insights and talent solutions Partner with local HR and business stakeholders to work actively on their hiring needs and build proactive pipelines Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion in all hiring practices Represent the company at external events and build strong employer branding initiatives Your background At least 3-5 years of experience in talent acquisition in a similar role ideally combined with experience working in an international or matrixed environment Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across all levels of the organization Good understanding of German-speaking labor market is mandatory Deep understanding of sourcing strategies, interview techniques, and assessment tools Fluency in English and German is mandatory (C1 level or mother tongue) Passionate about people, data-driven decision-making, and delivering results

jobs.title: Strategic Buyer – Direct Materials 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We're looking for an experienced Strategic Buyer – Direct Materials to strengthen our global procurement team. You'll manage a largely European supply market, with selective sourcing from Asia and world-wide, and play a critical role in ensuring production availability, our top priority. This role is ideal for a proactive, commercially minded sourcing professional who thrives in a complex, international environment and enjoys driving supplier performance, cost optimization, and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Develop and implement strategic sourcing plans to meet business objectives Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, negotiate contracts, and manage supplier relationships Conduct market research and analysis to stay informed of industry trends and best practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of procurement strategies with overall business goals Monitor and manage supplier performance, ensuring compliance with quality standards and delivery timelines, and continuous supplier development Drive cost reduction initiatives and identify opportunities for process improvements Negotiate contracts and coordinate supplier integration plans with internal clients Monitor market dynamics that impact materials\/services availability and\/or pricing Partner with internal clients to identify sourcing needs, support product development projects, identify demand, supply and market trends Your background Master's degree in science and supply chain management, Business Administration, or a related field 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing and procurement, preferably in a senior role Proven negotiation and contract management skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Proficiency in procurement software and tools, including SAP4HANA Strong communication and interpersonal skills Ability to read and interpret technical drawings Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. jobs.title: Internship Production Development 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and private transportation more energy-efficient, while our technology also enables the production and transportation of renewable energy from the production site to the consumer. A new production facility is being established in Prague for one of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) products. This move is motivated by considerations of capacity and business continuity. As part of your Internship in Production Development, you will assist with the transfer of production capabilities from Lenzburg to Prague. You play a vital role in facilitating the introduction and ramp-up of Hitachi Energy Semiconductors products at our second manufacturing site in Prague \/ Czech Republic. 
• Your responsibilities focus on ensuring operational excellence, process integrity, and effective knowledge transfer across locations. How you'll make an impact Supporting the implementation and qualification of new production tools, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards Assisting with equipment integration as well as the collection and analysis of production and process data Establishing process quality control procedures and corresponding control loops to maintain product consistency and compliance Organizing and supporting training of new production personnel, ensuring effective knowledge transfer from the Lenzburg site to the new factory Supporting product qualification by coordinating production of samples and testing activities Support the implementation of logistical flows for raw materials and processed parts between Lenzburg and Prague Ensuring comprehensive and accurate documentation of processes, work instructions, supporting materials, production tools, and their configurations, to support operational excellence and future audits Your background Study engineering, physics, chemistry, production technology, or related disciplines; holding a bachelor's degree is preferred. The assignment can be part of a master's thesis Show genuine interest in semiconductor backend manufacturing, including areas like innovative processes, logistics, and governance Show effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, as well as an interest in international collaboration and knowledge sharing Exhibit attention to detail in documentation and process setup, along with organizational abilities for supporting training, planning, and knowledge transfer Adapt easily to changing environments, embrace new tools, and commit to a six- to nine-month assignment split between Switzerland and the Czech Republic, supporting both operational and developmental activities English at minimum C1 level. Mastering of German is an advantage More about us This internship provides hands-on experience with manufacturing processes and operational excellence in a leading power semiconductor environment. It offers the chance to develop technical and organizational skills while supporting a major industrial expansion across Switzerland and the Czech Republic. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: R&D Power Semiconductor Chip Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.title: Produktionsmitarbeiter/in Montage 80–100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Montagefachkraft in der Produktion übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Fertigung unserer Produkte. Du richtest Produktionsanlagen ein, führst Montagearbeiten durch und stellst sicher, dass alle Arbeitsschritte gemäss Vorgaben hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit ausgeführt werden. Dank deiner Erfahrung erkennst du Abweichungen frühzeitig, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse sowie die Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Montage- und Produktionsarbeiten gemäss Spezifikationen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Qualitätsstandards Einrichten, Bedienen und Überwachen von Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsmitteln Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Produktionsablaufs unter Einhaltung von Termin-, Kosten- und Qualitätsvorgaben Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen sowie Identifikation, Analyse und Behebung von Abweichungen Bewegen, Sortieren und Verpacken von Materialien und Fertigprodukten Dokumentation von Produktionsdaten zur Unterstützung der Leistungsanalyse Unterstützung bei der Optimierung von Prozessen sowie Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen Fachliche Unterstützung und Einarbeitung von weniger erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene technische\/handwerkliche Berufsausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung in der Produktion Mehrjährige Erfahrung im industriellen Produktionsumfeld, idealerweise in Montage oder Fertigung Gute Kenntnisse von Produktionsprozessen, Arbeitsabläufen und Werkzeugen Fähigkeit, auch bei komplexeren Problemen strukturiert Lösungen zu erarbeiten Selbstständige, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wissen weiterzugeben Bereitschaft in 2-Schicht Betrieb zu arbeiten Mehr über uns   Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

jobs.title: Global SCM Training Leader, BU Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Training Leader for the Business Unit Transformers to join our global training and supply chain community. In this role, you will define and drive the strategic direction, development, and deployment of Supply Chain Management (SCM) training programs across the business unit. You will play a key role in strengthening supply chain capabilities, enabling business performance, and supporting standardization, transformation, and continuous improvement across regions and functions. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of SCM capability development, work closely with global and regional stakeholders, and contribute to innovate, inspire and deliver transformative results in forward-thinking supply chain organization. How you`ll make an impact Define and implement the SCM training strategy and roadmap aligned with Business Unit supply chain priorities and transformation initiatives Design, develop, and deploy global SCM training programs, ensuring consistency, scalability, and operational relevance for global, regional and factory teams Establish specific KPIs to measure effectiveness, impact, and continuous improvement of learning initiatives in line with Hitachi Energy SCM functional and BU Training governance Collaborate with SCM leaders, Subject Matter Experts, and global\/regional stakeholders to identify capability gaps and ensure technical accuracy of training content Support the adoption of standardized SCM processes, tools, and best practices through structured learning solutions Drive a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing across the SCM community Promote innovative learning approaches and digital solutions to enhance engagement and learning effectiveness Your background Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field Minimum of 10 years of experience in Supply Chain Management, training, learning & development, or a related functional leadership role Proven experience in designing, deploying, and governing global training programs within complex, matrix organizations Strong understanding of end‑to‑end SCM processes, including sourcing, planning, logistics, supplier management, and sustainability Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across global and regional teams Analytical mindset with experience in defining KPIs, measuring training impact, and driving continuous improvement Digital and technology savviness in managing and executing training using modern digital and AI-enabled technologies Ability to work effectively in an international environment and manage multiple projects\/initiatives in parallel with proven track record of successfully managed projects

jobs.title: High Voltage Testing Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a High Voltage Testing Engineer to join our high-voltage testing team at our MICAFIL bushing factory. If you are passionate about high-voltage testing and want to actively contribute to the future of our production processes, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute electrical and thermal type tests as well as special tests on high-voltage bushings (in-house and externally), considering available resources and budget Assist and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), including in-house FATs with customers Ensure the full functionality and availability of three high-voltage laboratories in collaboration with the team Lead and manage laboratory-related projects Ensure safety of equipment and personnel through training, instructions, and compliance with safety standards Secure quality, traceability, and compliance of bushing process steps through process instructions Perform routine, type, and special tests as required Continuously challenge and improve procedures and instructions as part of Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) As part of the Operations department, actively support and contribute to daily business activities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent Professional experience in high-voltage technology, testing, or electrical machines, ideally in a production or industrial environment Solid understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 17025 Business-fluent German and good English, both written and spoken Strong team spirit, high social competence, and enjoyment of working in a multicultural environment Flexible mindset with a strong enthusiasm for technology Proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for the efficient and compliant movement of goods within national borders, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to all domestic transportation and trade regulations. How you'll make an impact Plan, organize, and monitor domestic transportation of goods, including selection of carriers, negotiation of rates and optimization of routes to minimize costs and maximize efficiency. Prepare and process all necessary documentation for domestic shipments, such as packing lists and forwarding orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Prozess- und Anlagentechniker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position  Für unsere Industrie 4.0-fähige Produktion von Leistungshalbleitern suchen wir eine engagierte und technisch versierte Persönlichkeit als Process & Equipment Technician.  Mit deinem Know-how in Systemtechnik und Automatisierung sorgst du für eine hohe Anlagenverfügbarkeit, behebst Störungen, treibst Verbesserungen voran und unterstützt deine Kolleg\/innen bei technischen Fragestellungen. Gemeinsam mit dem Engineering-Team bringst du unsere Fertigung auf das nächste Level und begleitest die Integration neuer Anlagen in laufende Produktionsprozesse.  Das kannst du bewirken  Kalibrierung, Wartung und Instandhaltung von Anlagen und Komponenten  Eigenständige Fehlersuche und -behebung an komplexen Produktionssystemen (2.\/3. Level)  Präventive und zustandsabhängige Instandhaltung, um Stillstände zu minimieren  Dokumentation und Kommunikation des Anlagenzustands und technischer Anpassungen  Überwachung der Prozesskonformität und Qualitätskontrolle (SPC)  Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering und Support  Schulung und Unterstützung von Kolleg\/innen bei technischen Themen  Sicherstellung der Arbeitssicherheit in allen Tätigkeiten  Das bringst du mit  Abgeschlossene Ausbildung EFZ als Automatiker\/in, Elektroniker\/in oder Polymechaniker\/in  Fundierte elektrotechnische Grundausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung als Systemtechniker\/in  Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung oder Automatisierung von Produktionsanlagen  Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Steuerungstechnik, Pneumatik und\/oder Roboterprogrammierung  Strukturierte, analytische und selbstständige Arbeitsweise   Gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und Englischkenntnisse (B2)  Mehr über uns  Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen  Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen  Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

jobs.title: Troubleshooting Improvement Specialist 40 - 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Der Bereich GIS (gasisolierte Schaltanlagen) steht für höchste Qualität, Sicherheit und Effizienz – und genau hier setzt deine Rolle an. Als Troubleshooting Improvement Specialist unterstützt du aktiv bei der Analyse und nachhaltigen Verbesserung von Qualitäts- und Produktionsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen internen Fachbereichen zusammen, bringst neue Perspektiven ein und hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Probleme systematisch zu identifizieren und zu lösen.   Das kannst du bewirken Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Qualitätsmeldungen und Produktionsproblemen Mitarbeit an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Troubleshooting-Prozessen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering und Planung Unterstützung bei der Auswertung von Produktions- und Qualitätsdaten Dokumentation von Maßnahmen und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsinitiativen Mitarbeit bei internen Reviews und Audits   Das bringst du mit Laufendes Studium oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Industrial Engineering, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar Erste praktische Erfahrung im industriellen Umfeld von Vorteil, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Produktion, Industrialisierung, Digitalisierung oder Prozessautomatisierung Starkes Interesse an Produktionsprozessen, Qualität und Problemanalyse sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Grundkenntnisse in SAP, DSP, MES oder Datenanalyse-Tools sind ein Plus   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu gestalten. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Meinung zählt und du deine Ideen einbringen kannst – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht oder Hintergrund.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Project Manager to strengthen our Team in our Business Unit Transformers, Ticino. In this role you are leading the execution of medium-size projects mainly related to LV & MV Transformers and Reactors and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with Hitachi Energy policy, quality standards, health & safety and environment requirements. Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Please submit your resume in English. How you'll make an impact Developing project schedules, and determining resource requirements Monitoring and reporting on the status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing Ensuring adherence to internal and external quality standards (e.g., International Standards Organization) Manage After-Sales projects by ensuring the fulfillment of customer needs Identifying\/resolving obstacles to completing project on time and to budget May include work managing multiple, interrelated projects (including business transformation projects) On some projects, the work may include integrating vendor tasks into the project plan and tracking and reviewing vendor deliverables Your background Electrical Engineering or mechanical Engineering Background 2-3 years proven experience in Project Management with focus on Transformers and Reactors Collaboration with diverse number of stakeholders Very good knowledge of English and Italian; any other languages are a plus Strong communicator, self-driven and open-minded Structured and organized person with the ability to work under time pressure Team-player able to build and motivate a project team More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: System Engineer (SCADA/RTU) for Substation Automation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on  location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated semiconductor production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automation and metal joining technologies. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability and quality of bonding and welding processes, by applying data analysis tools and designed experiments Analyze production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Work on new automated production systems, improving production capacity and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing   Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment, ideally within the semiconductor industry Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy High Voltage Service supports customers worldwide with after-sales services for generator circuit breakers and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS). The team works closely with customers globally on installation, commissioning, maintenance, retrofitting and modernization. In this role, you will be closely involved with the product and work on construction sites around the world. You will take on responsibility, contribute your own ideas and gain valuable international experience through extended assignments abroad. Continuous learning, teamwork and professional development are an integral part of your daily work. How you'll make an impact Commission and test GIS systems in close cooperation with customer representatives Verify correct system functionality according to specifications and scope of supply Identify deviations and initiate corrective actions with project stakeholders Ensure compliance with site safety regulations and procedures at all times Apply and monitor environmental protection measures on site Participate in site meetings with relevant stakeholders Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanics, or a related field Initial experience in commissioning and\/or control system engineering Fluent German and English communication skills Ability to work independently under challenging site conditions Willingness to travel globally up to 90% of working time More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Standards Compliance Expert for Dry Transformers 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our team to drive the implementation of the latest internal and external standards in our Dry Transformers across all the factories in HUB Europe. This role offers you an exciting opportunity to broaden your expertise across various disciplines and functions, engage in dynamic projects and build a strong professional network both within and outside our organization. How you'll make an impact Be an active member of International Standards Committees, staying up to date with emerging changes and requirements and influencing standards development Support Product Management in developing and implementing our Global Technology Platform by engaging in requirements definition and supporting the rollout phases Work with teams from various functions, including Engineering, Operations and Quality. You will establish and maintain both internal and external networks to facilitate information exchange Oversee operations across multiple factories and work towards operational harmonization Ensure the effective implementation of both internal and external standards within our Power Transformers Units in Europe by conducting audits, identifying gaps and facilitating their resolution Responsible for communicating updates, deliver training sessions and provide support and technical guidance to colleagues on Standards Compliance related questions Represent our Company in standards-related discussions with customers and industry stakeholders Your background Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical or Mechanical are preferred) About 10 to 15 years of experience in the Power Transformer field Experience in Project Management and managing functional teams Deep knowledge of transformers design, manufacturing, testing and operations Interest in AI tools and their potential integration into one's work L6S green belt is preferred Excellent intercultural sensitivity and ability to develop and maintain healthy working relationships Strong communication skills, fluent in English, both written and spoken More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

How you'll make an impact Be an active member of International Standards Committees, staying up to date with emerging changes and requirements and influencing standards development Support Product Management in developing and implementing our Global Technology Platform by engaging in requirements definition and supporting the rollout phases Work with teams from various functions, including Engineering, Operations and Quality. You will establish and maintain both internal and external networks to facilitate information exchange Oversee operations across multiple factories and work towards operational harmonization Ensure the effective implementation of both internal and external standards within our Power Transformers Units in Europe by conducting audits, identifying gaps and facilitating their resolution Responsible for communicating updates, deliver training sessions and provide support and technical guidance to colleagues on Standards Compliance related questions Represent our Company in standards-related discussions with customers and industry stakeholders Your background Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical or Mechanical are preferred) About 10 to 15 years of experience in the Power Transformer field Experience in Project Management and managing functional teams Deep knowledge of transformers design, manufacturing, testing and operations Interest in AI tools and their potential integration into one's work L6S green belt is preferred Excellent intercultural sensitivity and ability to develop and maintain healthy working relationships Strong communication skills, fluent in English, both written and spoken More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity As a Field Service Technician, you will play a key role in maintaining the reliable operation of traction transformers across customer sites and in our factory. You will perform hands-on repairs, diagnose technical issues, and support customers directly. With your practical expertise, you will collaborate closely with internal teams and contribute to continuous product and process improvements. How you'll make an impact Always follow safety standards and company procedures during both field (60%) and factory (40%) activities. Perform on-site repairs and servicing of traction transformers, delivering prompt and professional solutions. Conduct field repairs, electrical diagnostic testing, and oil treatment at customer locations. Support failure investigations through disassembly, root-cause analysis, and the preparation of technical reports. Provide customers with technical support and training on equipment operation and basic maintenance. Contribute to small improvement projects aimed at boosting quality, efficiency, and service processes. Prepare service documentation, including work reports, material usage, quality inspection cards, and repair records. Collaborate with engineering, quality, project management, and sales teams to resolve escalated technical issues. In the factory, ensure effective coordination and execution of repair work alongside the Service team. Your background Completed technical apprenticeship or degree in Electrical\/Electrotechnical\/Maintenance fields. Minimum of 1–2 years of field service or technical repair experience, ideally in an industrial environment. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical cabling diagrams, and schematics. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for solving complex technical problems. Customer-oriented communicator, fluent in English; French is an advantage. Independent, self-driven, and flexible with working hours. Valid driving licence. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

jobs.title: Working Student Defectivity Engineering BIMOS 40% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Are you passionate about semiconductors and eager to gain hands-on experience in industry? We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented student to join our dynamic team for at least 6 months, with the possibility to extend. As a Defectivity Engineering Working Student, you will have the opportunity to work on real-world projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to ensuring the highest standards of our semiconductor product quality here in Lenzburg, Aargau.   How you'll make an impact Assist in identifying optical defects through non-destructive optical inspection  Support defectivity projects through data analysis and reporting on optical yield of our products Support regular maintenance of baseline and Pareto reporting systems Optimize and improve defect portfolio for various products Coordinate with various departments to correlate optical defects with equipment used in manufacturing process Your background Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Materials Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field Strong teamwork and communication skills Great attention to detail and persistence  Fluency in English, German language skills a plus Hands-on mentality and comfort working in a manufacturing environment More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Installation Project Manager 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit   In dieser Funktion übernimmst du am Standort Oerlikon die Organisation, Koordination und Führung aller Montage-, Inbetriebsetzungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Kunden zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Projekte effizient, sicher und mit hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.    Das kannst du bewirken   Verantwortung für die Abwicklung sowie die organisatorische Führung von Arbeiten vor Ort  Ansprechperson für interne und externe Kunden  Betreuung der zugeteilten Aussendienstmitarbeitenden und Erstellung von Montagezeitplänen unter Berücksichtigung von Ressourcen wie Verbrauchsmaterial, Werkzeug und Personal  Überwachung und Dokumentation von Projektfortschritt und - kosten (Reporting)  Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsanforderungen  Aktive Minimierung von Projektkosten und Risiken sowie prozessgerechte Bearbeitung von Abweichungsmeldungen inkl. Einleitung von Korrekturmassnahmen Vollständige Zusammenstellung, Ablage und Archivierung aller relevanten Dokumentationen (Red Marks, Prüfprotokolle, Berichte) zur As-Built-Erstellung sowie Verrechnung an den Kunden    Das bringst du mit   Technische Grundausbildung sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage und\/oder Inbetriebnahme von GIS-Anlagen  Fundiertes technisches Verständnis; Führungserfahrung von Vorteil  Technikerschule \/ Technischer Kaufmann  Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen von Vorteil  Sicheres Auftreten und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, insbesondere in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Kulturen  Teamfähigkeit, Organisationsstärke sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen Bereitschaft zu weltweiten Baustellenbesuchen Gute Kenntnisse in SAP und MS Office​ ​Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy setzen wir auf Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven stärken unsere Innovation und ermöglichen Lösungen, die unsere Energiezukunft nachhaltig prägen. Wenn du Teil eines globalen Teams sein möchtest, das gemeinsam Wirkung erzielt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Einleitung von Korrekturmassnahmen Vollständige Zusammenstellung, Ablage und Archivierung aller relevanten Dokumentationen (Red Marks, Prüfprotokolle, Berichte) zur As-Built-Erstellung sowie Verrechnung an den Kunden    Das bringst du mit   Technische Grundausbildung sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage und\/oder Inbetriebnahme von GIS-Anlagen  Fundiertes technisches Verständnis; Führungserfahrung von Vorteil  Technikerschule \/ Technischer Kaufmann  Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen von Vorteil  Sicheres Auftreten und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, insbesondere in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Kulturen  Teamfähigkeit, Organisationsstärke sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen Bereitschaft zu weltweiten Baustellenbesuchen Gute Kenntnisse in SAP und MS Office​ ​Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy setzen wir auf Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven stärken unsere Innovation und ermöglichen Lösungen, die unsere Energiezukunft nachhaltig prägen. Wenn du Teil eines globalen Teams sein möchtest, das gemeinsam Wirkung erzielt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR
jobs.description: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us Be part of a global digital transformation initiative. Work on cutting-edge GenAI solutions. Collaborative culture with opportunities for career growth and innovation. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. * * Applicable  only for Poland location align with local law regulations

jobs.title: Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide. In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. How you'll make an impact Lead the laboratory team, including resource management and team development (15 FTE) and act as the point of contact for HV testing at Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC\/IEEE) Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity  Ensure high output through reliable high-voltage testing procedures (AC, DC, impulse, partial discharge) Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with your team and our Process Engineering team Collaborate closely with planning, quality assurance, logistics, other production departments and relevant stakeholders for holistic process design and improvement  Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Technical apprenticeship and qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) in the field of Electrical Engineering or equivalent Several years of experience in a similar leadership position (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Solid knowledge in high-voltage systems, generators, and automation systems Solid knowledge of lean management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety Excellent time management, communication and organizational skills Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. jobs.title: Praktikant Praxisintegriertes Bachelorstudium (PiBs) Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen 40% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Starte deine Karriere mit einem praxisnahen Einstieg in die Industrie und gestalte unsere Produktion durch datengetriebene Prozessoptimierung aktiv mit. Du setzt dein theoretisches Wissen aus dem Studium – etwa aus Methoden- und Projektmanagement – direkt in die Praxis um und sammelst dabei wertvolle Erfahrungen. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, das dir Sicherheit und Selbstvertrauen für deinen Berufseinstieg gibt. Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und ein engagiertes, unterstützendes Team begleiten dich auf deinem Weg zum erfolgreichen Bachelorabschluss. Hinweis: Das Praktikum ist ausschliesslich in Kombination mit einem praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudium an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz FHNW \/ Zürcher Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften ZHAW möglich. Weitere Informationen findest du hier: Link zu FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studium\/technik\/pibs Link zu ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studium\/bachelorstudium\/praxisintegriertes-bachelorstudium\/ Das kannst du bewirken Automatisiere Geschäftsprozesse mit Power BI, Power Automate oder Power Platform Betreue und begleite sowohl bestehende als auch neue Projekte Arbeite mit Manufacturing Equipment Systems (MES) und Datenbanken Erstelle Prozessabläufe nach BPMN 2.0 und treibe die Digitalisierung (Process Mining, Citizen Development und Businessanalysen) voran Verbinde technisches Know-how mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Denken und setze die Theorie in Praxis um (Requirement Engineering) Lerne bei uns wie man verschiedene Anspruchsgruppen abholt um erfolgreich Wirkung zu erzielen (Change Management) Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Gymnasiale Matura (Voraussetzungen für die Zulassung an der Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Offenheit, Proaktivität und Selbstmotivation Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise Fliessendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), Kenntnisse in Englisch (B1) Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen dir, persönliche und berufliche Ziele zu verbinden. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen kannst – unterstützt durch Mentoring und eine inklusive Kultur. Haben wir dein Interesse Geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive CV, Motivationsschreiben und Zeugnisse.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Service ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Als Kollege\/-in in unserem weltweit tätigen Service Team schätzen Sie die selbstständige, abwechslungsreiche und lösungsorientierte Arbeit. Nach einer vielseitigen, praxisorientierten Ausbildung in der Schweiz und im Ausland, werden Sie rund um den Globus GIS Installationen und Wartungen leiten. Es erwartet Sie eine technisch herausfordernde Stelle in einem multikulturellen Umfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Leitung von multikulturellen Baustellen weltweit für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen für das Spannungslevel von 110KV – 550KV Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung der vor Ort Installation, Wartungen und Reparaturen unter Einhaltung vertraglicher Termine und unter Berücksichtigung lokaler gesetzlicher Vorgaben Verantwortlich für die Qualität der vor Ort ausgeführten Arbeiten mittels Qualitätskontrolle und Beurteilung der Fähigkeiten von lokalen Hilfskräften Durchführen von Produkttraining vor Ort am Produkt und während der Installation Verantwortlich für die Evaluierung von Risiken und deren Minimierung. Koordination und Anweisung von Arbeitskräften Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßiges Rapportieren an die Projektleitung Aktives Mitarbeiten an Prozessverbesserungen und proaktives Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung der Tätigkeiten vor Ort Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilbranche Elektrotechnische Grundkenntnisse sind ein Muss, elektrotechnische Weiterbildung von Vorteil Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Montage- und Inbetriebsetzungsbereich Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und vor allem internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 80 % Reisetätigkeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Flair für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungssuche mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum Attraktive Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung Interessante und vielfältige Tätigkeiten\/Projekte – auch mit Auslandseinsätzen Eingespieltes und dynamisches Team Offene Unternehmenskultur Attraktives Leistungspaket inklusive fixer Vergütung, Reise- und Verpflegungskosten sowie Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft
