jobs.title: Teamleader Design Engineering - Generator Circuit Breaker 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. How you'll make an impact Coach and lead a team of CAD Designers, ensuring high quality creation, modification, and maintenance of engineering data for generator circuit-breaker systems and components (team size approx. 10 FTE) Develop\/enhance\/maintain master data of all GCB products with 3D-models, drawings and bill of materials in CAD\/PLM systems  Implement special designs, cost-saving projects and drive product quality improvements Initiate and establish design-process improvements Ensure efficient collaboration with other engineering functions, project leads and further stakeholders Contribute to apprentice supervision and training together with the apprentice advisors of the team As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Solid technical foundation as senior designer or equivalent engineering background Proven experience and confident handling of CAD tools (preferably Creo) Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (preferably PTC Windchill), roles, object management, and release processes Experience in a team leading function or as a project manager of a project team Distinct self-organization skills, as well as precise, independent working style Ability to structure work, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple design topics simultaneously with high quality and reliability Mindset oriented toward process improvement, document quality, and establishing structured working methods Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer - Dry Transformers 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Joining our Dry Transformer engineering team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of design specifications and models, ensuring they meet all relevant standards and regulations Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring design milestones are achieved and projects are delivered on schedule  Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and seek opportunities for design innovations Engage with customers to capture and incorporate their feedback into design solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components Prepare and maintain detailed documentation that supports design processes and facilitates knowledge sharing Identify and implement continuous design improvements based on test results and industry best practices, enhancing quality and efficiency Your background Degree in electrical engineering or a related field 2-5 years of experience in electrical design engineering of dry type transformers Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team  English is a must, Italian is beneficial Pro-active attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact  
• Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team
• Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement
• Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams
• Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization
• Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment
• Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions
• Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities
• Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation
• Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background  
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
• 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products
• Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies
• Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills
• Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact  
• Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team
• Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement
• Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams
• Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization
• Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment
• Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions
• Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities
• Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation
• Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background  
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
• 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products
• Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies
• Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills
• Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer​ – Energy & Power (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our High Voltage Products division is a worldwide specialist in power transmission and distribution. Our Service Unit supports customers around the globe with Generator Circuit Breaker systems (GCB) and gas‑insulated switchgear (GIS). From training and commissioning to maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and replacements — we ensure critical power infrastructure works reliably, safely, and efficiently. Service is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our international service team, you'll take on varied, hands‑on work and become a recognized product expert. After comprehensive, practical training in Switzerland, you'll travel the world to commission and maintain GCB systems — all while working in a dynamic, multicultural environment. This is a role with real impact, technical depth, and plenty of room to grow. How you´ll make an impact Lead multicultural service projects for GCB on power plants from 20 MW to 1600 MW worldwide Ensure smooth and timely execution of installation and maintenance work on site Perform the final quality check and guarantee that all work meets our high standards Deliver product training directly to customers at their facilities Identify risks proactively and implement effective mitigation measures Coordinate on‑site teams and give practical, clear instructions Manage resource and provide regular reporting to project management Drive process improvements and implement efficiency‑boosting initiatives on site Your background Completed apprenticeship in metalwork, electrical engineering, or automotive technology Solid electrical knowledge (essential); further education such as a technician diploma is a plus Minimum 2 years of professional experience; experience in site leadership is an advantage Good English skills (B2 or above); German is a plus High willingness to travel — up to 80% worldwide Flexible, resilient, and communicative team player who enjoys solving problems pragmatically and values high safety and quality standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

jobs.title: Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems - Europe
jobs.description: The Opportunity As the Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems HUB Europe, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the strategic direction, performance, and growth of our Substation Automation portfolio across the region. You will oversee all commercial, operational, and technical aspects of the HUB, ensuring excellence in project execution, customer satisfaction, and business results. This role reports to the HUB Leader and collaborates closely with global Product Management, R&D, and cross‑regional teams. Location is flexible within Europe and will be confirmed during later stages. This role requires frequent travel within Europe and occasional international travel. How You'll Make an Impact Drive Strategic Direction & Business Growth: Develop and execute the HUB's strategy in alignment with global objectives. Identify market opportunities, expand customer relationships, and grow sales in substation automation solutions including protection relays, SCADA, control systems, and communication technologies. Lead Operational Excellence: Oversee engineering, project delivery, sales support, and service execution. Define and track KPIs to secure efficient operations, on‑time delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong financial performance. Strengthen Customer & Market Presence: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders across Europe. Represent Hitachi Energy as a subject matter expert at industry forums and customer engagements. Ensure Financial Performance: Manage budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability targets. Identify improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce cost. Advance Technical Expertise & Innovation: Stay at the forefront of substation automation technologies, industry trends, competitor movements, and regulatory changes. Promote innovation and technology adoption across the HUB. Champion Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure operations comply with internal policies, industry standards, and European regulations. Promote a strong safety and quality culture across all teams and activities. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with global product management, R&D, and other regional business units to share best practices, align strategies, and maximize value from the full Hitachi Energy portfolio. Lead & Develop High‑Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and empower a strong team of engineers, project managers, and commercial professionals. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in the power transmission and distribution industry, with deep expertise in substation automation systems, of which 5–7 years in a leadership role managing a business unit, department, or similar organization within a multinational environment. Strong technical knowledge across substation automation architectures, protective relaying, SCADA, control systems, IEC 61850, and cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. Proven success in business strategy execution, P&L management, contract negotiation, and complex project delivery and strong understanding of the European energy market, customer landscape, and regulatory environment. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence across a matrix environment. Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an asset.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Electrical Engineer for Medium Frequency Transformers 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva and shape the future of energy. As a Senior R&D Electrical Engineer, you will work on cutting-edge transformer technologies in a dynamic, international environment. You'll be part of a collaborative team, contributing to the full R&D lifecycle—from concept to testing and product launch, ensuring that our solutions meet both technical specifications and market demands. This role offers hands-on experience, technical growth, and the chance to make a real impact in the energy transition. How you will make an impact Apply your knowledge of electromagnetism to support innovative concepts' validation through simulations Tackle a variety of engineering challenges on Medium Frequency Transformers Contribute to the development of new features in our internal design tools Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new technologies\/products in collaboration with global teams Align your work with our strategic technology roadmap Take ownership of work packages and deliver results using a structured approach Deepen your understanding of transformer technologies and support internal consulting to optimize your R&D activities Contribute to intellectual property and risk management activities in R&D Your background MSc or PhD in Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering, ideally with experience in R&D within a business environment Knowledge of electromagnetism and circuit theory with ability to perform electromagnetic simulations Proficiency in MATLAB and\/or Python Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) Analytical thinking and ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary and international teams Awareness of business processes related to product development More about us 
• We offer flexible working practices and a supportive environment where you can grow your skills and career. What you can expect from us Exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Inclusive and diverse work culture Discounts on fitness memberships and various services Attractive pension benefits through our company pension fund

You'll be part of a collaborative team, contributing to the full R&D lifecycle—from concept to testing and product launch, ensuring that our solutions meet both technical specifications and market demands. This role offers hands-on experience, technical growth, and the chance to make a real impact in the energy transition. How you will make an impact Apply your knowledge of electromagnetism to support innovative concepts' validation through simulations Tackle a variety of engineering challenges on Medium Frequency Transformers Contribute to the development of new features in our internal design tools Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new technologies\/products in collaboration with global teams Align your work with our strategic technology roadmap Take ownership of work packages and deliver results using a structured approach Deepen your understanding of transformer technologies and support internal consulting to optimize your R&D activities Contribute to intellectual property and risk management activities in R&D Your background MSc or PhD in Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering, ideally with experience in R&D within a business environment Knowledge of electromagnetism and circuit theory with ability to perform electromagnetic simulations Proficiency in MATLAB and\/or Python Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) Analytical thinking and ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary and international teams Awareness of business processes related to product development More about us 
• We offer flexible working practices and a supportive environment where you can grow your skills and career. What you can expect from us Exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Inclusive and diverse work culture Discounts on fitness memberships and various services Attractive pension benefits through our company pension fund

jobs.title: Commissioning & Start-Up Engineering Experienced Professional (f/m/d) 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
The opportunity In this role, you will plan, prepare, and coordinate all pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and start‑up activities through to successful handover. You will develop and maintain commissioning plans, schedules, manuals, test procedures, and documentation, ensuring all activities meet customer, quality, and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with engineering, project management, and third‑party partners to resolve technical issues, obtain required approvals, and secure customer acceptance. Working independently, you will apply your technical expertise to drive safe, efficient, and compliant commissioning execution while contributing to continuous improvement and supporting the wider project team. How you'll make an impact
• Carry out testing and commissioning of control and relay panels and substation automation systems across various locations in Singapore
• Execute commissioning activities safely in line with Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards, reporting hazards and near misses
• Ensure a positive customer experience and manage customer relationships professionally
• Perform commissioning according to documented processes and checklists, resolving open points and securing customer sign‑off
• Report site progress and planning and ensure efficient use of commissioning assets such as test kits and tools
• Hand over marked‑up drawings for as‑built preparation and final submission to the customer
• Identify and monitor risks in your area of responsibility, ensuring stakeholders remain informed
• Provide guidance to associate commissioning engineers and coordinate tasks with junior staff or small Your background
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical field
• Several years of hands‑on experience in commissioning protection, control, or substation automation systems
• Solid knowledge of protection relays, substation communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850), and related testing tools
• Strong understanding of safety standards and compliance requirements in utility or industrial environments
• Experience interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation
• Ability to interact confidently with customers, engineers, project managers, and external stakeholders
• Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work independently at customer sites More about us At Hitachi Energy, diversity and collaboration are central to how we work. We believe that bringing together different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas strengthens our teams and drives innovation. You will join a global environment where people support each other, learn from one another, and work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

jobs.title: GPG Engineering design Platform Lead
jobs.description: The opportunity The role involves leading & ensuring the execution of the backlog according to priorities. Candidate will drive design platform process improvements, maintain burnup dashboards, and track agreed programming KPIs. This role requires strong leadership, coordination with R&D, and support for users on technical questions. How you'll make an impact Ensure backlog execution according to priorities. Drive continuous improvements in the design platform process. Maintain burnup dashboards and monitor programming KPIs. Provide effort estimations during the prioritization process. Coordinate with R&D to ensure clear understanding of Technical Specifications (TS). Address users' tickets and escalate issues when necessary. Support users on technical questions and provide guidance. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background ​ 7+years of experience with Masters or Bachelor of Engineering in mechanical design, Information technology. Proven experience in mechanical design and development. Strong understanding of technical specification development and R&D workflows. Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage priorities and drive timely execution. Experience in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements and maintain KPIs

jobs.title: Research Team Manager - Circuit Breaker (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We are looking for a passionate Research Team Manager . You will be responsible for leading our multidisciplinary Circuit Breaker research team in Baden-Dättwil (Switzerland), part of the Central European Hitachi Energy Research Center.    How you'll make an impact   You are a leader : Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting your team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology   You are impactful: Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives  Contribute to an innovative and motivating working environment   You foster collaboration: Maintain and extend an excellent network to relevant business units and   leading universities  Promote collaboration between all Hitachi Energy Research Centers    You contribute: Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, covering electrical emergency first aider role (Training will be provided) Oversee different research laboratories, including safety   Your background   PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in following areas: circuit breaker, high power testing, plasma physics, and an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and proven track record in industrial R&D, with relevant people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); proficiency in German is an advantage   If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, apply!

jobs.title: Business Analyst Global Product Group DT
jobs.description: The Opportunity: As a part of Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers team, you will be responsible for business analysis for core digitalization projects including Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA and Matterport within 25 factories in the portfolio scope. You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics How you'll make an impact Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area. Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates. Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability. Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities. Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool. Collaborate with global teams, HUBs, and factories to gather requirements and deliver tailored reporting solutions. Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency. Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective. Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT. Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS.   Your background Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments. Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling. Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate). Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of functional and business analysis. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully .* * A pplicable   only for Poland location align with local law regulations

descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity: As a part of Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers team, you will be responsible for business analysis for core digitalization projects including Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA and Matterport within 25 factories in the portfolio scope. You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics How you'll make an impact Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area. Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates. Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability. Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities. Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool. Collaborate with global teams, HUBs, and factories to gather requirements and deliver tailored reporting solutions. Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency. Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective. Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT. Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS.   Your background Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments. Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling. Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate). Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of functional and business analysis. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully .* * A pplicable   only for Poland location align with local law regulations

jobs.title: Project Control Engineer for Power Converters 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description:
Über die Position Starte deine Karriere mit einem praxisnahen Einstieg in die Industrie. Du setzt dein theoretisches Wissen aus dem Studium direkt in die Praxis um und sammelst dabei wertvolle Erfahrungen. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, das dir Sicherheit und Selbstvertrauen für deinen Berufseinstieg gibt. Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und ein engagiertes, unterstützendes Team begleiten dich auf deinem Weg zum erfolgreichen Bachelorabschluss. Hitachi Energy bietet Dir interessante 
• Aufgaben in einem hoch motivierten Engineering Team im Bereich Technical Project Engineering. Hier beschäftigst Du dich mit dem Design und Abwickeln von Umrichter-Systemen in den Bereichen Power Quality (STATCOM), Bahnnetzkupplungen, Netzkupplungen und Pumpspeicheranlagen. Hinweis: Das Praktikum ist ausschliesslich in Kombination mit einem praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudium an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz FHNW \/ Zürcher Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften ZHAW möglich. Weitere Informationen findest du hier: Link zu FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studium\/technik\/pibs Link zu ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studium\/bachelorstudium\/praxisintegriertes-bachelorstudium\/ Das kannst du bewirken Unterstützung des Engineering Teams bei der Realisierung von Kundenprojekten während der Abwicklungsphase  Erstellung von Zeichnungen \/ Schemata \/ 3D-Modellen, die den individuellen 
• Anforderungen der Kunden entsprechen Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption innovativer, kundenorientierter Lösungen  Anlegen und Pflegen von Stücklisten \/ Materialien im ERP-System SAP Pflege von Zeichnungen \/ Schemata \/ und Dokumenten im Dokumenten Management System (DMS) Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Gymnasiale Matura (Voraussetzungen für die Zulassung an der Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Interesse an Technik und Energiesystemen und Freude am Arbeiten in interdisziplinären Teams Gute Kenntnisse von Microsoft Office und Affinität zu CAD Tools Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise  sowie Bereitschaft zur eigenen kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung Fliessendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), Kenntnisse in Englisch (B2) Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen dir, persönliche und berufliche Ziele zu verbinden. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen kannst – unterstützt durch Mentoring und eine inklusive Kultur. Haben wir dein Interesse Geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive CV, Motivationsschreiben und Zeugnisse.

jobs.title: Business R&D Senior Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy serves customers in the utility, industry and infrastructure sectors with innovative solutions and services across the value chain. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition towards a carbon-neutral future. At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories.  Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact on our communities and society. How you'll make an impact You will lead comprehensive requirements analysis with cross-functional teams to understand user needs and complex system constraints, ensuring alignment with industry standards at Hitachi Energy.  You will engage proactively with key stakeholders to define project objectives and clarify updates, facilitating effective communication and gathering insights for improved project outcomes. You will foster strong relationships with key customers, utilizing their feedback to drive continuous improvement in the mechanical design platform. You will implement newly developed products in a mechanical design platform that ensures high performance and responsiveness, collaborating closely with R&D teams to exceed customer expectations. You need to conduct in-depth risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies to minimize potential impacts on mechanical design platform project timelines and budgets.  You will be supporting champion agile methodologies by organizing regular sprints and retrospectives to enhance team collaboration and adapt to changing requirements.  You will oversee testing and debugging processes to guarantee software quality, utilizing advanced tools to identify and resolve defects effectively.  You will act as a subject matter expert within projects, offering guidance to colleagues. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing by actively distributing insights, best practices, and lessons learned to promote collaboration and continuous innovation within the team. You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background You hold a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field. 5-10 years of experience in design engineering with a proven track record of leading design projects. Or a minimum of 5 years of experience in software development within the transformer industry or a comparable technical field. Solid knowledge of Creo modelling (Pro\/Program, Sheet-Metal, Family table, Interchange, Relation, Skeleton, Assembly) Advanced proficiency in programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, VB, C+ or C++, with extensive experience in leveraging software development frameworks to deliver complex solutions. In-depth knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies, with a proven track record of effectively leading teams through all phases of development. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the capability to perform comprehensive risk analysis. Ability to bring fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the design process.  Strong collaborative skills with the ability to foster an environment of innovation and teamwork among colleagues. Willingness to travel and ability to interact with colleagues in different time zones, as position is Global. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. More about us Hitachi Energy Korea have been awarded the following honor [Best Practice in Remote Work

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Are you passionate about driving innovation and enhancing manufacturing processes? As an Equipment Engineer, you'll be at the heart of optimizing production systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and shaping the future of semiconductor technology. This role offers a dynamic environment where your ideas and expertise will directly impact equipment performance, safety standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and grow within a supportive and forward-thinking team, we'd love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Ensure equipment reliability by engaging in proactive maintenance and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives (CIP) Promote a safe work environment by applying 6S principles and supporting ABRA safety protocols Collaborate across teams to support modernization, expansion, and smooth operation of production lines Support documentation efforts by contributing to daily task records and developing troubleshooting resources Contribute to system upkeep by helping maintain production planning software (SiView) and updating equipment databases and logs Participate in audits and help address safety-related action items and improvements Support technical operations by assisting with system maintenance and ensuring production aligns with current best practices Your background Technical apprenticeship with subsequent specific extension courses, or degree in electronics, mechanics, or physics, or equivalent education At least 5 years of experience in maintaining semiconductor production systems (preventive measures, troubleshooting, repairs, documentation), especially with production equipment used in photolithography Know-how in tools for resist coating \/ developing (Screen 80B\/80EX) and exposing (Ultratech 1500 \/ Canon i3000W\/3030i5a Steppers) Good command of German and English mandatory, any other language advantageous Willingness to work in shifts Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills More About Us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.
